Partisan gerrymandering poses a threat to the very fabric of our democracy.
|

Friends,
There’s no “off season” in redistricting — it’s a perpetual fight, and it’s happening _right now._
**That’s why last week, All On The Line, alongside our affiliates, announced our most ambitious initiative yet: our 10 Year Plan to build a more representative democracy.**
Every single day, we’re working to protect fair maps, combat ongoing gerrymandering, and prepare for upcoming redistricting battles in key states — but we need to know you’re right here alongside us.
[**Add your name today to become a fair maps champion and recommit to the movement for fair redistricting! → **](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80527209/459616236/779549763?source=20240308_AOTL_F_Recommit_RedLite&refcode=20240308_AOTL_F_Recommit_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY1MDA5OWM5LWRlZGMtZWUxMS04NWZiLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FgcarIaFZ2fF_HNqKnyl7KYt9NgHniYCA2Ac1riygTg=&emci=2e000779-bedc-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=f50099c9-dedc-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=8431045)

**But what they don’t realize is that we have a secret weapon: YOU!**
If you join the countless others from every corner of the country who are recommitting to fighting for a fair redistricting process, we’ll be able to continue to build momentum for fair maps and safeguard our democracy.

Thank you for being a dedicated member of this movement.

My name is Katherine Clark, and I proudly serve Massachusetts’ 5th district in Congress. I am also in House leadership serving as the Democratic Whip.

It wasn’t too long ago when there were hardly any women serving in Congress at all. When I first came to Congress in 2013, I was stopped and mistaken for someone’s spouse (multiple times), making it difficult to even get into the Chamber to cast a vote.

Fast forward to today, and thankfully, things have improved. **There are more women serving in Congress than ever before — 94 women in the House Democratic Caucus alone!**

But our work is far from over. This election, there’s so much at stake for women. While House Democrats continue to fight for reproductive freedom, Donald Trump brags about overturning _Roe_ , and has promised to lead the charge to ban abortion nationwide.

We cannot afford to let their extreme MAGA agenda win — for our freedoms, our families, or our futures.

name: Doug Lindner, LCV
subject: Tell Congress: Pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act NOW >>
body:
Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding a judiciary that works for people and our planet.

Tell Congress to Rein in the Supreme Court

The Supreme Court just heard arguments in two key cases that threaten the EPA's and other agencies' ability to protect the people from big business.

Congress must stop MAGA judges' right-wing power grab. Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding that Congress rein in the Supreme Court and urgently prioritize confirming pro-environment, pro-democracy judges. https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv.

Peter - the Supreme Court just heard arguments in two critical cases - Relentless, Inc. v. Department of Commerce and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo - that could gut the federal government's authority to enforce even the most basic environmental protections.

In both cases, corporate interests backed by big oil are suing in order to hamstring federal agencies' authority to protect people from powerful special interests. If these plaintiffs get their way, it would move authority over every area of public policy from public-interest agencies like the EPA to the MAGA-dominated federal courts.

In the last two years, extremist Justices on the Supreme Court have already severely limited the federal government's ability to regulate climate pollution from power plants, stripped Clean Water Act protections from most of the wetlands in the United States, and overturned Roe v. Wade. Some even take lavish gifts like private jet flights from the same billionaires bringing cases like this for them to rule on. Now, they're looking to overturn a bedrock doctrine of the American legal system in order to increase their own power.

Our planet and our communities are counting on us - we need your help to make our voices heard. We're asking 5,000 LCV members to take action before midnight tonight. Tell Congress to take action to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies with pro-environment, pro-democracy judges before it's too late >> https://links.messages.lcv.

These critical cases target what's called the Chevron Doctrine. This longstanding Supreme Court precedent says that when something is unclear in a federal law administered by an expert agency, such as the way the EPA administers the Clean Air Act, federal courts should defer to agency experts' reasonable interpretations of what the law means. The Chevron Doctrine is critical to enforcing the laws that protect our environment and our communities from pollution and other harms. It touches every issue, from climate to democracy to healthcare, reproductive rights, consumer protection, workers' rights, student debt, and so much more.

Put simply, if the Supreme Court rules in favor of the plaintiffs in Relentless and Loper Bright, it will gut the ability of federal agencies like the EPA to implement the laws Congress passes, transferring that power to unelected right-wing judges. And if Congress doesn't act, far-right judges will keep control of our Supreme Court, and keep rolling back our rights, for decades to come.

Congress must stop this MAGA power grab. We need lawmakers to pass the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. They must also pass the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act to ensure our nation's highest court doesn't have the lowest ethical standards. And we need the Senate to prioritize confirming President Biden's pro-environment, pro-democracy judicial nominees to every vacancy on the federal bench.

We can rein in corrupt MAGA judges, Peter, but it will only happen if our movement joins together to demand it. Please, take action right now. Tell Congress to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies. It only takes a moment to help us reach our goal >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/bxyvTqW_

Thank you for joining LCV's campaign for a democracy that works for our planet and for our communities.

Onward,

Doug Lindner
Senior Director of Judiciary & Democracy
League of Conservation Voters

TAKE ACTION NOW Peter - the Supreme Court just heard arguments in two critical cases - Relentless, Inc. v. Department of Commerce and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo - that could gut the federal government's authority to enforce even the most basic environmental protections. In both cases, corporate interests backed by big oil are suing in order to hamstring federal agencies' authority to protect people from powerful special interests. If these plaintiffs get their way, it would move authority over every area of public policy from public-interest agencies like the EPA to the MAGA-dominated federal courts. In the last two years, extremist Justices on the Supreme Court have already severely limited the federal government's ability to regulate climate pollution from power plants, stripped Clean Water Act protections from most of the wetlands in the United States, and overturned Roe v. Wade. Some even take lavish gifts like private jet flights from the same billionaires bringing cases like this for them to rule on. Now, they're looking to overturn a bedrock doctrine of the American legal system in order to increase their own power. Our planet and our communities are counting on us - we need your help to make our voices heard. We're asking 5,000 LCV members to take action before midnight tonight. Tell Congress to take action to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies with pro-environment, pro-democracy judges before it's too late >> These critical cases target what's called the Chevron Doctrine. This longstanding Supreme Court precedent says that when something is unclear in a federal law administered by an expert agency, such as the way the EPA administers the Clean Air Act, federal courts should defer to agency experts' reasonable interpretations of what the law means. The Chevron Doctrine is critical to enforcing the laws that protect our environment and our communities from pollution and other harms. It touches every issue, from climate to democracy to healthcare, reproductive rights, consumer protection, workers' rights, student debt, and so much more. Put simply, if the Supreme Court rules in favor of the plaintiffs in Relentless and Loper Bright, it will gut the ability of federal agencies like the EPA to implement the laws Congress passes, transferring that power to unelected right-wing judges. And if Congress doesn't act, far-right judges will keep control of our Supreme Court, and keep rolling back our rights, for decades to come. Congress must stop this MAGA power grab. We need lawmakers to pass the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. They must also pass the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act to ensure our nation's highest court doesn't have the lowest ethical standards. And we need the Senate to prioritize confirming President Biden's pro-environment, pro-democracy judicial nominees to every vacancy on the federal bench. We can rein in corrupt MAGA judges, Peter, but it will only happen if our movement joins together to demand it. Please, take action right now. Tell Congress to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies. It only takes a moment to help us reach our goal >> Thank you for joining LCV's campaign for a democracy that works for our planet and for our communities. Onward, Doug Lindner Senior Director of Judiciary & Democracy League of Conservation Voters

name: Ruben Gallego (via Mazie Hirono)
subject: The team that will win in Arizona
body:
|
#
_Hi Peter, this is Mazie. I am proud to join Senate Democrats in supporting Ruben Gallego's campaign for Arizona's crucial Senate seat. If we're going to hold on to our Democratic majority and defeat Kari Lake, a dangerous MAGA extremist, Ruben will need our support. Please read his urgent message below and split a donation between our campaigns today._
* * *
Peter, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect. I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark. One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors. And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her. I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. clean_body: | Hi Peter, this is Mazie. I am proud to join Senate Democrats in supporting Ruben Gallego's campaign for Arizona's crucial Senate seat. If we're going to hold on to our Democratic majority and defeat Kari Lake, a dangerous MAGA extremist, Ruben will need our support. I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark. One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors. And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. Deep Challenges Affect Rural Americans
To improve the 'State of our District,' we need solution-based leadership that promotes economic opportunity, healthcare, education, infrastructure, and more.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Farm_2.png]
This is the last month of the fundraising quarter, and we're off to a slower-than-usual start for March. Thank you for considering pitching in tonight. Every dollar counts and will enable me to continue my efforts to break the GOP's hold on rural America.
If you've saved your payment information with Act Blue Express, your contribution will process immediately.
CONTRIBUTE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=express_lane_10]
CONTRIBUTE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25]
CONTRIBUTE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=express_lane_50]
Friend,
Before 2000, rural and urban Americans did not vote all that differently, but this has changed rapidly over the last generation, and by 2022, 74% voted GOP nationwide.
We are worse off because of it. We earn about 10-20% less than our urban counterparts, but our living costs are the same. Our infrastructure is crumbling. Our youth are leaving, we are aging, and our graduates aren't staying.
Liberals and "wokeness" didn't kill the family farm and bring manufacturing jobs overseas.
College professors didn't pour mountains of opioids into rural communities.
Immigrants didn't shutter rural hospitals and let rural infrastructure decay.
It was corporations prioritizing profit before 'We, the People'. It was decades of neglect, poor Congressional leadership, divestment, and the abandonment of rural ideals.
Friend, I'm not just here to sell doom and gloom. I want to offer all of us hope. It doesn't have to be this way.
To bring economic opportunity to rural America and make the American Dream more of a reality, we need:
*
Strong
schools
*
Good
broadband
and
other
vital
infrastructure,
including
healthcare
*
An
affordable
place
to
live
with
strong
families,
clean
air,
water,
and
land.
*
And
let's
remember
family
planning
-
the
ability
to
plan
when
to
raise
children.
This is what Democrats like me support. Democrats may have lost the voters in rural areas, but I'll never lose faith in our ability to be better, our ability to change - to elect common-sense, principled leadership to reverse the tide.
WE CAN DO THIS!
It is up to us. We must:
*
Focus
on
creating
a
recreation-based
economy
to
replace
the
old
one
based
on
resource
extraction.
*
Provide
a
welcoming
environment
to
promote
diversity
and
be
an
engine
of
revitalization
*
Resist
the
predations
of
corporate
consolidation
and
promote
small
businesses.
We need to create a movement with a vision for the future with all of us.
Our future depends on it.
Thank you for your continued support.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

| As we gear up for tonight's State of the Union address, I find myself reflecting on the past year and the road that lies ahead. It's a pivotal moment for our nation, and I am eager to hear President Biden articulate his vision for our future—a future I believe we can shape together.

In the past year, we faced extremist legislation that further attacked reproductive rights. Kate Cox’s story made headlines across the country after she was forced to travel out of Texas to seek an abortion. Just a few weeks ago, the Alabama Supreme Court went a step further and put in vitro fertilization (IVF) in jeopardy.

We’re now facing a Trump-Biden rematch in November, and the work we do now will determine if we go back to a Trump presidency that laid the foundation for right-wing extremism.

**Delivering common-sense solutions for West Michiganders remains my utmost priority.[_Tonight, I’ll be listening intently, hoping to hear a strong commitment to the issues that remain close to us. Dear Peter,
As an independent candidate for President of the United States, I am reaching out to you with a critical message about the state of our union.
Growing up, I witnessed an America that seemed to have achieved its promise as an exemplary nation – a beacon of freedom, prosperity, and peace. Unfortunately, over the past few decades, we have lost touch with that vision.
Now, we face serious challenges such as chronic illness, violence, loneliness, depression, division, and more. Our great cities have turned into tent encampments, leaving many dispossessed Americans and undocumented immigrants living in despair.
It's evident that our government institutions have faltered and that our leaders have forgotten the difference between true leadership and bullying. The values of integrity and moral authority that were once synonymous with America are now a distant memory.
But here's the good news: we can still restore the America we almost had, the America that was the envy of the world. We just need to be honest with ourselves and recognize the reality we face.
_Our country is hungry for healing._
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-sotu-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=sotu_video_3_7_24_a4&n=5)
---
Everywhere I go, I see Americans who are determined to come together and rebuild. We may have become the sickest country on earth, but we also possess ingenious healers, innovative recovery solutions, and dynamic regenerative farmers.
Our economic problems are undeniable, but we also have ambitious entrepreneurs who can turn the tide. Hunger and homelessness may persist, but our philanthropic rates and bottomless kindness show that we have the compassion and resilience to make a difference.
Although it may seem that our nation is more divided than ever, I firmly believe that Americans everywhere want to bridge that divide. We are tired of being manipulated by fear, and we reject the politics of divisiveness.
In fact, 80% of Americans are tired of being forced to choose between the lesser of two evils. We no longer want to vote against something or someone; we want to vote for hope, healing, and an inspiring vision for America's future.
So, I invite you to join me in this journey of restoration. Together, we can end the forever foreign wars, clean out the corrupt Washington establishment, and turn towards a future of peace, freedom, good health, and prosperity.
To hear more about my vision and how we can work towards reclaiming the America we once knew, [I encourage you to watch this video:](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-sotu-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=sotu_video_3_7_24_a4&n=6)
[WATCH NOW](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-sotu-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=sotu_video_3_7_24_a4&n=7)
Remember, when we unite behind this vision, we become unstoppable. Let's rebuild our nation and fulfill the promise of America.
Thank you for your support, and may God bless America.
| |
---
---
Sincerely,
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.
Independent Candidate for President of the United States

Friend,
_Abortion is under attack in America._
In less than two years, since Roe v. Wade was overturned, we've watched our country be pushed backward to an era of extreme bans, dangerous policies, and attacks on patients and doctors. In my home state, abortion is now banned after a mere 15 weeks. But evidently, that already extreme, unpopular ban wasn't enough for Ron DeSantis: **_He's also signed a six-week ban, which could take effect in the next few months._**
We're seeing a similar story play out in states across the country. Far-right legislators are pushing bills to criminalize abortion procedures, threaten doctors, undermine access to birth control, ban interstate travel to access abortion care, and so much more. **The Alabama Supreme Court has even issued a ruling that jeopardizes access to IVF treatment!**

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: are you ready for tonight?!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I know I’ve emailed you a couple times over the past few days about President Biden’s _State of the Union_. . .

But it’s happening TONIGHT at 9:00 P.M. (ET), and I don’t know about you. . . but I’m expecting him to harp on expanding abortion, _i.e. killing precious babies,_ the entire time.

After all, President Biden and his Vice President, Kamala Harris, have admitted that restoring _Roe v. Wade_ is their **_TOP_** priority should they win a second term.

Pro-Life Friend, there’s even rumors Biden is bringing a special “guest” tonight – someone that proves the “need” to impose abortion throughout all nine months of a pregnancy.

Well, we’re bringing a special guest of our own – Ryan Bomberger, _a man whose story is SURE to make media elites’ heads explode!_

You see, Ryan’s birthmother chose Life for him after he was conceived in rape, and his presence and life testimony at the _State of the Union_ will make the pundits’ heads spin and remind everyone – _especially President Biden and Vice President Harris_ – that Life is precious and matters.

**[So, your immediate action is critical to _Students for Life Action_ as we prepare to counter President Biden’s pro-abortion agenda tonight](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-skyukit-duchtdja-y/)!**

This is our chance to prove to Congress and the Biden Administration that **_WE’RE NOT GOING AWAY_!**

The fact is, that’s what they desperately want us to do. . .

As I told you, _Students for Life_ was recently declared a **terrorist** group by the University of Maryland’s “National Consortium for the Study of Terrorism and Responses to Terrorism” (START), **which is affiliated with the Biden Department of Homeland Security!**

As infuriated as I am about that, I’m not about to cancel our plans to crash President Biden’s _State of the Union._

Instead, we’re doubling down – including launching our _Students for Life Action_ 2024 Social Media Ambassador program TONIGHT as we’ve been training our young people to combat abortion misinformation online.

And there’s going to be a TON!

But with these students speaking the TRUTH, we can combat the LIES and propaganda.

Tonight, we have to show President Biden we’re here to stay, and we’re not _**EVER_** going to give up.

**[So please, I’m counting on trusted supporters like you Pro-Life Friend, to make a generous gift to help us have a strong pro-life presence TONIGHT at the Capitol](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-skyukit-duchtdja-j/)!**

Pro-Life Friend, you aren’t a terrorist but you are critical to the fight for Life.

It’s time to send a strong **PRO-LIFE** message to the Biden Administration and ALL members of Congress.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Building a bolder, more progressive Texas – one election at a time / Construyendo un Texas más audaz y progresista: una elección a la vez
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Mobilizing thousands of voters in the Texas primaries around an unapologetic #TexasForAll vision
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Sean%20Teare%20TOP%20Harris%20County%20crew.JPG]
TOP PAC launched an intensive candidate screening process at the end of 2023 with the goal of endorsing primary candidates who are unwavering in their commitment to protecting our rights and freedoms, and fighting far-right MAGA extremism ― all while transforming our state into a place where Black and Latino Texans can thrive. The result was a slate of 13 endorsed leaders ready to champion progressive policies that will benefit ALL communities across our state. These past four weeks, TOP PAC’s get-out-the-vote campaign knocked on 128,567 doors in Bexar, Dallas, and Harris counties , informing working Texans not only about our endorsed candidates, but about issues that affect their daily lives ― ranging from housing and healthcare, to immigration reform, legal system reform, and public education.
Our voter engagement work is critical in connecting everyday issues to the ballot box and, ultimately, the officeholders who we elect and work to hold accountable. We saw this in real-time Tuesday, as TOP PAC’s GOTV program helped unseat Harris County DA Kim Ogg, an incumbent who turned her back on implementing reforms, to elect Sean Teare (pictured above), who is committed to restoring public trust in the DA's office. [https://www.texastribune.org/2024/03/05/harris-county-district-attorney-primary-kim-ogg/] TOP PAC's on-the-ground consistent voter engagement work is such an important part of our mission to create a true Texas that reflects our values and uplifts each and every person ― regardless of age, race, gender, income, or faith.
There is no way to establish progressive power in our state — to actually create a Texas that works for everyone — without meaningful and consistent voter engagement in Black and Latino neighborhoods . Each and every election cycle, TOP PAC works to expand and strengthen the progressive infrastructure in our communities, which allows us to connect with these voters and mobilize them around issues that matter deeply to them. This is how we change the political landscape in our state and put more power into the hands of Black and Latino Texans.
We proudly celebrate the success of the following TOP-endorsed candidates who have either advanced or emerged victorious in their Democratic primary races:
Harris County
Sean Teare [https://seanteareforda.com/] for Harris County District Attorney (Win)
Christian Menefee [https://www.menefeeforhc.com/] for Harris County Attorney (Win)

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7b51fcb722844ed6a99e00c5aca252ac&_e=3xMLlkF9pKvlLRgWknJPI4fk9qHltBAUlPjc_7ILxD5pQiXVplS_z9YAFqlfq5OV8L-ktHXCQ8R-ET96K3kIkV5645M5C48Lv8FETDTylRRYqF7tN0SmeXvlG5yC_rZuo9D5LH2dlV-Zwz4b7V3t5oC6FUtzNDPWpj-IHsriAqTgneEibpGVIPpQbE0R0KkBFsvRnWW2Mq2Cqr83BS3U3pve36aAqaOlyM6o7Ay0w97OtYT4JryxKU7NN4uSIX4nwO4UqZypTl2po3e5QorcpCM8GRrO_qJNUfTJ8vfa8Xq-_iTZDlUmGgzjILoS655yLLy3_7YxgvGus-Bes9YvLIIGYRlYawN7OIvkpAXP2_hTVJVlN1cr74WzvD4rx7is1DhrSwPVHJYyEtNRMRoA1w%3D%3D) **
As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7b51fcb722844ed6a99e00c5aca252ac&_e=3xMLlkF9pKvlLRgWknJPI4fk9qHltBAUlPjc_7ILxD5pQiXVplS_z9YAFqlfq5OV8L-ktHXCQ8R-ET96K3kIkV5645M5C48Lv8FETDTylRRYqF7tN0SmeXvlG5yC_rZuo9D5LH2dlV-Zwz4b7V3t5oC6FUtzNDPWpj-IHsriAqTgneEibpGVIPpQbE0R0KkBFsvRnWW2Mq2Cqr83BS3U3pve36aAqaOlyM6o7Ay0w97OtYT4JryxKU7NN4uSIX4nu-ngIkEo_ehOqW5fOQcKbqehidoi6Uwzqo4o4ee8zsr9XS1w3f9WaDk4VQAI-chBYdKMvhNMA1StTnBF5NZI05BF7VVPlzjAXHbRNuNQUr0Y66Ls5amN32gDqe4z1SnjPl_U0YwIY43CvnmLpqgCvg%3D%3D)

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7b51fcb722844ed6a99e00c5aca252ac&_e=3xMLlkF9pKvlLRgWknJPI4fk9qHltBAUlPjc_7ILxD5pQiXVplS_z9YAFqlfq5OV8L-ktHXCQ8R-ET96K3kIkV5645M5C48Lv8FETDTylRRYqF7tN0SmeXvlG5yC_rZuo9D5LH2dlV-Zwz4b7V3t5oC6FUtzNDPWpj-IHsriAqTgneEibpGVIPpQbE0R0KkBFsvRnWW2Mq2Cqr83BS3U3pve36aAqaOlyM6o7Ay0w97OtYT4JryxKU7NN4uSIX4nIrtVY2lh20rVWH7967rVKypIikxRTGYkhRajxu9OgTeGpmz_p8UxUZetrlt3sGp1xFVyGgCB3sZB7eq2WfulPDXljdB0TpBajOUGlbuqR6jPctx5llGTJgcD3rI3TvbwPS-YVAPWuhE9wTrEIChHiw%3D%3D)

clean_body: As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive. | Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this | | | | Fellow Patriot, I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive. Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? Regards, Dr. Ben Carson Founder and Chairman American Cornerstone Institute | | Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods to decrease the federal government's role in society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens. | | Copyright(C) 2024 American Cornerstone Institute, All rights reserved. .

_A record spike in violent crime._
_A raging virus that would take more than 1 million American lives and leave millions of loved ones behind._ I came to office determined to get us through one of the toughest periods in our nation’s history. And I am asking you to join me in the fight to move our country forward. | | | Peter, I just finished my State of the Union address. I hope you’ll give me a chance to share with you how far we have come, where we have yet to go, and then, if you are moved, Take a second to think back to 2020. Just four years ago this week -- before I came to office -- our country was hit by the worst pandemic and the worst economic crisis in a century. We all remember the fear. Record job losses. A record spike in violent crime. A raging virus that would take more than 1 million American lives and leave millions of loved ones behind. I came to office determined to get us through one of the toughest periods in our nation’s history. And we have. Just look how far we’ve come. It doesn’t make the news -- but in thousands of cities and towns -- the American people are writing the greatest comeback story never told. Together, we are building a new era of American possibilities. We are building an economy from the middle out and the bottom up -- not the top down. We are investing in all of America to make sure everyone has a fair shot. We have turned a setback into a comeback. That’s America. That is who we are. We must keep fighting for it. The very idea of America is that we are all created equal and deserve to be treated equally. While we’ve never fully lived up to that idea, we’ve never fully walked away from it either. name: Hillsdale College via Pro Life Update
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zi5s6oldvbn6kjdd2dnq9u3h6ts58vitrrg5e2go_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3ieaor6c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zlsk1nns27g3rojno1uc07gvd995ogn0lv6ls0do_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3ieaor6c5h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp3o3ot28surumfg6mrlud48p5rgnahsf1ocutag_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3ieaor6c5h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Your America
subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30477%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zTh8lrY%2fL%2b%2f3ynMNY615ew&sysid=1) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30478%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IBRAqmtaZ1%2fM7%2f%2f9J7wRoQ&sysid=1) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer “sound learning” in order to preserve “the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty.”** Yet today’s ruling class mocks people of faith as “backward,” “bigots,” and even “Christo-fascists.” Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you “get bitter” and “cling to guns or religion.” These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today’s government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That’s why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include “Inside the Transgender Empire” by Christopher F. Rufo, “The Most Important Decision in Life” by Bishop Robert Barron, and “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. * Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqlovfa13u02eofpsioamn3qi3ffft8ehu09ils8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3ieaor6c5h2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5pkp9v6hnfkp21afm56u33t5e967e8b1t0chhp8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s3ieaor6c5h2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

I can’t explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

| |

| | | Friend,

I can’t explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

**With that being said, could you do me the simple favor of just reading this all the way through to the end?** If you get to the end and still don’t think you have the power to make a difference, then I just want to thank you for your time.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we’d be able to hit all of our goals.

# Take your Health Back!
Alright, everybody, strap in because I've got something absolutely mind-blowing to share with you, especially all my folks in California and the surrounding areas. This is not your average health benefit – we're talking about a game-changer!
Now, I've been through the wringer when it comes to health. Yeah, I shed a whopping 500 pounds recently, but guess what? The battle's far from over. My body's still screaming in pain, and I'm staring down the barrel of two knee replacements. Back and hips? They're on a constant pain playlist, and the list of issues just keeps growing.
So, what do you do when the traditional pharmaceutical game doesn't cut it? You dig deep, you research, and you look for alternatives. And let me tell you, my skepticism led me to a revelation that's going to blow your minds!
About a month back, my buddy of 20 years, Pastor James Fortune, hit me up with news that changed the game for him and his wife, Canada. They discovered a treatment so good, it sounds too good to be true. But hold on – it's legit! We're talking medical documents, x-rays, blood tests – the whole nine yards.
I practically dragged Pastor James Fortune to Los Angeles because I knew you needed to hear this. We're hosting him at not one, but two locations in LA County. Picture this: an amazing catered dinner on us, and all the info you need to make educated decisions about taking charge of your health and living your absolute best life right now.
Don't procrastinate until your body breaks down even more. It's time to restore your youth, break free from the pain, and live the life you've been dreaming of. This is your shot, my friends – seize it!

# Take your Health Back!
Alright, everybody, strap in because I've got something absolutely mind-blowing to share with you, especially all my folks in California and the surrounding areas. This is not your average health benefit – we're talking about a game-changer! Now, I've been through the wringer when it comes to health. Yeah, I shed a whopping 500 pounds recently, but guess what? The battle's far from over. My body's still screaming in pain, and I'm staring down the barrel of two knee replacements. Back and hips? They're on a constant pain playlist, and the list of issues just keeps growing. So, what do you do when the traditional pharmaceutical game doesn't cut it? You dig deep, you research, and you look for alternatives. And let me tell you, my skepticism led me to a revelation that's going to blow your minds!
About a month back, my buddy of 20 years, Pastor James Fortune, hit me up with news that changed the game for him and his wife, Canada. They discovered a treatment so good, it sounds too good to be true. But hold on – it's legit! We're talking medical documents, x-rays, blood tests – the whole nine yards. I practically dragged Pastor James Fortune to Los Angeles because I knew you needed to hear this. We're hosting him at not one, but two locations in LA County. Picture this: an amazing catered dinner on us, and all the info you need to make educated decisions about taking charge of your health and living your absolute best life right now. Don't procrastinate until your body breaks down even more. It's time to restore your youth, break free from the pain, and live the life you've been dreaming of. body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkb-OnDAQh5_GdEazNhhTUKzErRTp7hJpi5TI2AM7K2Nb2CTK20cot33a-TTf_Pn9_Jg-DHkK66fZcKCcpz1PwUwP8p67-OTZeJ6PfRIgGg6Sg55E5YZWXPSiKxwuHfS6b6US1WPoUal5bqQ2bY_SNYvSnVRqMeaierdARcPpAQkadNMJqKWzne5mbOdWdqpbWANHcqZgTSGTw2xjTCl6KmRzHfe18sOjlJSZvDJxY-LmU30um53xWKM7mLg5TGYvG4bC48KfRy5k8bziF_45m-QtWyZHuEADnyAa8Q7X8fv49nZnQh1lm3I8dotMjmmPOaEtFNYvtKGjY2NyxM2Q_ypasyVDa2BydPH5GvQPxVAwFCbH-_V9-nHl3-53_npCtQ8u_SbvKauONbCeztrGrSr_m8XfAAAA___-aJCx) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkb-OnDAQh5_GdEazNhhTUKzErRTp7hJpi5TI2AM7K2Nb2CTK20cot33a-TTf_Pn9_Jg-DHkK66fZcKCcpz1PwUwP8p67-OTZeJ6PfRIgGg6Sg55E5YZWXPSiKxwuHfS6b6US1WPoUal5bqQ2bY_SNYvSnVRqMeaierdARcPpAQkadNMJqKWzne5mbOdWdqpbWANHcqZgTSGTw2xjTCl6KmRzHfe18sOjlJSZvDJxY-LmU30um53xWKM7mLg5TGYvG4bC48KfRy5k8bziF_45m-QtWyZHuEADnyAa8Q7X8fv49nZnQh1lm3I8dotMjmmPOaEtFNYvtKGjY2NyxM2Q_ypasyVDa2BydPH5GvQPxVAwFCbH-_V9-nHl3-53_npCtQ8u_SbvKauONbCeztrGrSr_m8XfAAAA___-aJCx)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkb-OnDAQh5_GdEazNhhTUKzErRTp7hJpi5TI2AM7K2Nb2CTK20cot33a-TTf_Pn9_Jg-DHkK66fZcKCcpz1PwUwP8p67-OTZeJ6PfRIgGg6Sg55E5YZWXPSiKxwuHfS6b6US1WPoUal5bqQ2bY_SNYvSnVRqMeaierdARcPpAQkadNMJqKWzne5mbOdWdqpbWANHcqZgTSGTw2xjTCl6KmRzHfe18sOjlJSZvDJxY-LmU30um53xWKM7mLg5TGYvG4bC48KfRy5k8bziF_45m-QtWyZHuEADnyAa8Q7X8fv49nZnQh1lm3I8dotMjmmPOaEtFNYvtKGjY2NyxM2Q_ypasyVDa2BydPH5GvQPxVAwFCbH-_V9-nHl3-53_npCtQ8u_SbvKauONbCeztrGrSr_m8XfAAAA___-aJCx)** Thank you for your time and attention. **I Won the election**
My friends, supporters, and fellow believers, I extend my heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who cast their votes in my favor and lifted me up in prayer throughout this campaign journey. With immense joy and profound humility, I am honored to announce my resounding victory in the election to the prestigious LA County 66th Assembly District Republican Central Committee.
Not only did we triumph, but we did so with an unprecedented margin, surpassing all other contenders in every other district. This victory stands as a testament to the unwavering dedication and unyielding support of our community. I am profoundly humbled by your trust and confidence in my leadership.
As I prepare to assume office this December, I pledge to serve with unwavering integrity and steadfast commitment to the principles that guide us. My foremost allegiance lies not only to the constituents I represent but also to a higher calling – a commitment to honor and please the Lord in all that I do.
This pivotal step forward is but a milestone on the journey toward greater influence within the governmental sphere. It is a strategic move, laying the groundwork for future endeavors and positioning us to wield greater impact in shaping the destiny of our beloved nation.
Whether it be at the state level or on the federal stage, rest assured, this triumph sets the stage for even greater achievements in the seasons to come. Together, we shall continue to march forward, united in purpose and driven by a shared vision for a brighter, more prosperous future.
Once again, from the depths of my heart, I extend my sincerest gratitude to each and every one of you. Our victory is a testament to the power of unity, faith, and unwavering determination. Together, we shall forge ahead, guided by the enduring principles that define us as a nation. Thank you, and God bless America.
Sincerely,
Derrick R. Gates
[officialderrickgates.com](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5257?id=213275.288.1.1147c736a4889b419c48fc4f895d070d)
## The Border War
---
My fellow citizens, Today, I write you with a heavy heart, burdened by the stark realities I witnessed firsthand at our nation's border. I embarked on a journey fueled by duty and curiosity, to delve into the depths of the border conflict that has gripped our nation's attention. What I encountered there was beyond comprehension, beyond what any of us could have imagined. In my pursuit of truth, I stumbled upon scenes that shook me to my core. I could not turn away, for it is our duty as leaders, as stewards of this great nation, to confront the harsh realities that confront us. With profound urgency, I present to you a brief glimpse into the depths of this crisis, a testament to the importance of addressing these challenges head-on. I implore each and every one of you to bear witness to this footage, to let it serve as a call to action, a rallying cry for compassion, for empathy, and for decisive action. Together, we can and we must confront the challenges that lie ahead, for the sake of our nation, for the sake of our humanity. Please, click the link below to view the video, and join me in the journey. I will be returning next week to spend a few days.

| Hi friend,
Something big happened in the world of building electrification, and it's not getting the mainstream attention it deserves.

**In case you missed it, here's the latest:**
* A group of mostly Trump-appointed judges in the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals knocked down the city of Berkeley's landmark ban on installing gas hook-ups in new buildings.
* This decision is a big deal because many cities across the country who want to follow in Berkeley's footsteps—or already have—are left wondering what happens next.
* Despite this latest attempt by fossil-fuel-funded Republicans to block climate action, [there are several paths forward for local leadership to cut indoor air pollution and decarbonize buildings anyway.](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2388150/87SdQ4wZ)

I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qpg9bKKVv1pBI_oD_lXXGA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnzYlQP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzA4VwNzcGNCCmXq1OzqZQ9ssAdSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

name: Hillsdale College via Defend the Constitution
subject: Religious Liberty is Under Serious Threat
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=38f7e4b3bf45432888688f9506f106a2&_e=Bx0YGUfzLai3uwTTl7fEhjdJ54gomhT-vNC-HzwkWW2tlt7AwoalCnr9oRd4CL4wEQzVj73-zuhMUT6U32ehP1NE4Ark7q9NZz0bklXMgKf7LEGtxkf81c2RDTv24_M3U1JwzFluPEUd4lcOPoWwRez3QpKZNhEqc_8Rn6AMmPNadEPuHQT8A0KCQndcza4AEJCt3SVwBivl7QfoiKzde6xXWiYG3QlJB6U6ORQvWgtC2Y8zDcuDMaA5XgMacWws6m_shvBjUj_cd8tTp0uV9Bj_6yJccsZzWuYUjPgFIY-kwBEwPBjLHsxlIvejJRqabMTt_8LllxreqPF8nSvVz02ko3fOVy_vVbxx2qeHYBMZ-HhNc8JNbq8vSB4OHjxbRyih49495D1Jh-d3b0aMCg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=38f7e4b3bf45432888688f9506f106a2&_e=Bx0YGUfzLai3uwTTl7fEhjdJ54gomhT-vNC-HzwkWW2tlt7AwoalCnr9oRd4CL4wEQzVj73-zuhMUT6U32ehP1NE4Ark7q9NZz0bklXMgKf7LEGtxkf81c2RDTv24_M3U1JwzFluPEUd4lcOPoWwRez3QpKZNhEqc_8Rn6AMmPNadEPuHQT8A0KCQndcza4AEJCt3SVwBivl7QfoiKzde6xXWiYG3QlJB6U6ORQvWgtC2Y8zDcuDMaA5XgMacWwsPyrL211aTuFPPr5sE1wwd354i1SBrl0psY1k-WnYNOIJjF-hTwHmiscuc0Wjlij30KSnBqh7j6U3WUjICR1iejNzcXzw70_XrT_XYQ8137IR2jcTKYnhlWmBixUj6VenMVg2psH02QRwAKkAyF2bZg%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=38f7e4b3bf45432888688f9506f106a2&_e=Bx0YGUfzLai3uwTTl7fEhjdJ54gomhT-vNC-HzwkWW2tlt7AwoalCnr9oRd4CL4wEQzVj73-zuhMUT6U32ehP1NE4Ark7q9NZz0bklXMgKf7LEGtxkf81c2RDTv24_M3U1JwzFluPEUd4lcOPoWwRez3QpKZNhEqc_8Rn6AMmPNadEPuHQT8A0KCQndcza4AEJCt3SVwBivl7QfoiKzde6xXWiYG3QlJB6U6ORQvWgtC2Y8zDcuDMaA5XgMacWwsjde-X4zsfTS1BC7SuC06JqXOiEcBFyz4rn95HJDLd9vmilU6slmW0ak2ToxhTMAMHIEC-IigJAdUVFJ8Eh16AgOjL6WMiBcGlhghosUKHRXiAiXiC8jaAfsNZ-QvjzlTlmw9HPFKVG40sykw-Ah3Jw%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fdf182e635474e59851a7f96d4b31eb0&_e=TLrGQrImMujS8jmuGVmts4rn02eesODlaUk6JPYYP0PtQiRNUiYiVDTTEOk_IH5CQJx9hmrFOjs9d-d0vSN1v22ImcYPjc2bI0rHZ8KE_JFvkrkbb31F12I6b-SWO35uG277QYj4nbkfQxb9N-Z0T5UL16Bqi0P1DfwoWMObzmayT63OfW2OesjidIkOBwyva5VzXSty0z_Q-3VCXnUBYDiF73aDkbcm3LrFyxlH2tU2BM0PhQGkRe4U0Jl92EJxdKScelywpAlMSywYWzPEAdvlNhDXx7RZ-GJ6N7i0v-23DhyxN_vv05xMSynqKI0hSi9k3JX1vUfzbjlM-7XsvYbfRzYutq1Tg-9E-fOBxXZFHN639ekqhSNj0VLtNDda95S7kGEJewXMpMj0wJ7d_A%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fdf182e635474e59851a7f96d4b31eb0&_e=TLrGQrImMujS8jmuGVmts4rn02eesODlaUk6JPYYP0PtQiRNUiYiVDTTEOk_IH5CQJx9hmrFOjs9d-d0vSN1v22ImcYPjc2bI0rHZ8KE_JFvkrkbb31F12I6b-SWO35uG277QYj4nbkfQxb9N-Z0T5UL16Bqi0P1DfwoWMObzmayT63OfW2OesjidIkOBwyva5VzXSty0z_Q-3VCXnUBYDiF73aDkbcm3LrFyxlH2tU2BM0PhQGkRe4U0Jl92EJxOoXful43tAHRFzHL9Rl02tMehVLpEG4gbMgP_fKw9SQyZEQt8yFHhE9814c37FUCqWGOoSwa7CD5LhfS2J8gwJf5_FwII-JWrxNYt286g0VkBQOcpJyikBoQ9bygT_LzehMJEYZehT9tEjVtmFESAg%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Hoosier Republican Leadership at its Best_**
---
Friends, Along with many of you, we watched President Biden's State of the Union Address last night. Much like his presidency, President Biden missed the mark, with a complete disregard for rising costs, our wide open border, and decaying public safety. As we listened, we were reminded again as to why the hard work our team is putting in to make 2024 a year of change is so important. Now more than ever, it is crucial that Hoosier Republicans come together and sign up to help us bring this much needed change. That means fundraising, knocking on doors, making phone calls, attending grassroots events, and much more! With your help in all these areas, we are confident that we will be successful in November and will get our country going in the right direction again. As we acknowledge the shortcomings of the federal government, let's remember that because of Hoosier Republicans, we have great leadership right here in Indiana at every level of government, from the grassroots up! We currently have a record number of Republican mayors statewide, 12 years of super majorities in both chambers of the General Assembly, and have had a Republican in the governor's office for almost 20 years. From yearly tax cuts and balanced budgets, to strong economic development and thriving local communities, _**Indiana Republicans have worked together as a team to put Hoosiers and their families first! **_ Please sign up [HERE](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/9af85052d100e7eec3d6b838967d376c/40313) to help us continue to build on our success from here and take back the White House in 2024. Thank you for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
