# 💪 Hoosier Republican Leaders are Taking Action on the Border 🚀

---
---
| | Border security and immigration policy are issues that should be handled by the federal government. But because of failed Democrat leadership in our nation's capital, **Hoosier Republicans are stepping up to lead.**
* Following his [visit to the southern border](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/105854bc62f47812c3d6b838967d376c/40313), Gov. Holcomb [committed 50 members of Indiana’s National Guard](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/3c9497fa4091e231c3d6b838967d376c/40313) to assist Texas in their efforts to protect the southern border.
* Activating our National Guard costs money, so Senate President Pro Tem Rodric Bray [pledged to refill](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/896526d50a76be5dc3d6b838967d376c/40313) the line item in our state budget in the 2025 session, so we are assured our National Guard troops are funded for their service at the border, which is usually funded by the federal government.
* The Indiana General Assembly passed [Senate Bill 181](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/5a4b1930393ff7e6c3d6b838967d376c/40313), which would reinforce Indiana’s policy against sanctuary cities, which are localities that limit or deny cooperation with federal immigration authorities in enforcing immigration laws.
* Indiana law already bans local governments from enacting "sanctuary city" policies and bans public and private colleges from enacting "sanctuary campus" policies. However, the enforcement mechanism under our law was struck down by the courts on technical grounds.
* SB 181 fixes this issue so our law against sanctuary cities can be enforced. Under the bill, the Attorney General has the ability file a lawsuit to stop a city or college from enacting a sanctuary city/campus policy.

In his State of the Union Address last night, we saw President Biden try to push the blame for his border crisis on Republicans. Actions speak louder than words, and Republicans have taken ACTION! **Here is what Republicans leading on this issue are saying: ** [Eric Holcomb: Why I'm sending the Indiana National Guard to the Texas border](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/e8365eb37f093dc3c3d6b838967d376c/40313) [Sen. Rodric Bray Op-Ed: America’s wide open southern border threatens Hoosiers.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/8ae576a377bd2e0ec3d6b838967d376c/40313) [Koch: Bill to enforce Indiana's ban on sanctuary cities moves to governor's desk.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/fc966c72d445fa59c3d6b838967d376c/40313) [Huston statement on Gov. Holcomb deploying Indiana National Guard for Texas border security mission.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/74f5d55dcded1b7cc3d6b838967d376c/40313)

# 2024 Republican National Convention Internship and Volunteer Programs
---
---
Applications are open for the 2024 Republican National Convention Internship Program! The Committee on Arrangements (“COA”) plans for and manages the Republican National Convention. See the one pager with more information above. To apply for the COA Internship Program, please submit the following:
1. [RNC Internship Application](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/2af69dc3efbcb0373947229f28c3afba/2ead58270e03eb7dc3d6b838967d376c/40313). Please include your Resume and Personal Statement with your submission on the application portal
2. Two Letters of Recommendation emailed to coainterns@gopconvention2024.com

To ensure a timely review of your application all materials are due by March 31, 2024. The COA Internship Program is a structured, full-time, unpaid internship, and positions are limited. The COA Internship Program begins Thursday, June 6, 2024 and concludes Sunday, July 21, 2024\. Hours of business are Monday – Friday, 8:30 a.m. – 5:30 p.m. (days and hours subject to change at the discretion of COA or intern supervisors). There are also exciting volunteer opportunities available at the national convention.The MKE 2024 Host Committee is looking for volunteers to help guests at the 2024 Republican National Convention. Team, as of noon today, qualifying is over and the field is set. Every Republican in the race for Georgia’s 3rd District is a conservative who supports Trump. **The question is who has the right experience and focus to get things done.** **It’s time to send an Army Ranger to Congress, not another DC staffer or privileged insider.** **I am an Army Ranger who deployed to more than 32 countries, including multiple hostile fire zones. I retired as a Lt. Colonel in 2008.** I was the Georgia Senate Majority Leader for four years, during which time we delivered one conservative victory after another. I wrote the 2021 Election Integrity Act. I helped pull Constitutional Carry over the finish line. And we delivered the largest income tax return in Georgia’s history. **My record speaks for itself, and no other candidate can match my experience. ** **I am 100% in this race to win it, because too much is at stake for our district, and our country, to get this wrong. ** **This race is going to be a fight, and it’s a fight I intend to win. # Striking Down Noncitizen Voting Is a Victory for the Constitution
By Rob Ortt
A New York court made the right call, but Democrats aren't giving up on their campaign to let noncitizens vote.
###

In late February, the Appellate Division of the New York State Supreme Court issued a ruling that should comfort all Americans who love and defend our Constitution and the rule of law.
In [a 3-1 ruling](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-WhyKlG5wzQg5KGv5TYz8oJkKdCtzME9YCIvpy6bgYSped7wSsEYYK9CEw34ayN0RO_VMUJ8MyO1OmWNPbqWP7HzQo04DD8D86GVlMgEvDFQnZvby8vajJcFI0EMb7FTAZQm56MG41ZCkqWYeDpKbEY-gbcH7xoilceRd6XsLwprD4fUQ01VyX5PX9WVJXgk_0DwMg0d5MsPFfxMJ5Swm5y2nQHN1s0vU_dlL9IgvDFRauVhbl9ziIDn0FR-vhgHhud-_3Oqx2YVlkrMz10L9g==&c=eil7OvZ6OHHjxv2K0k7KdevvUlVpI-bj-CKc_4l3Dfwb-sIxN3WoIw==&ch=fvs8-ULIhAequ8Tzsa2Itp1JcmJ_t7jpV4tOMfzycuYLOUJkVcfP0w==), the court ruled unconstitutional a law that was approved by New York City's Mayor Eric Adams, sponsored by Councilman Ydanis Rodriguez, and pushed through with the help of his far-left allies; this law would have given noncitizens the right to vote under the guise of being "municipal voters." The case came before the court after Borough president Vito Fossella, Councilman Joseph Borrelli, Assemblyman Michael Tannousis, and my colleague Deputy Senate Minority Leader Andrew Lanza -- all of whom represent Staten Island -- filed a lawsuit challenging the constitutionality of law. The court agreed, affirming that the clause in the New York State Constitution "every citizen shall be entitled to vote" refers exclusively to United States citizens.
Allowing noncitizen voting devalues the constitutional right of law-abiding American citizens to participate in our democracy. The law would have weakened citizens' votes, opening the possibility for stacking the ballot box and enabling voter fraud. Why are some elected officials in our state pushing for noncitizens to vote in violation of fundamental and established constitutional principles? The unfortunate and frightening answer is one word: power.
New York is a deep-blue state. Democrats hold the governor's mansion, both houses of the state legislature, the New York city council, and the mayoralty. But for them, it's not enough. They strive for total dominance. They want an irretrievably one-party state. And no law or constitutional principle -- no matter how fundamental and sacrosanct -- will stand in their way as they impose their will.
Extremist Democrats have made New York into a haven for criminals and illegal immigrants. They have sprung criminals out of jail by preventing judges from imposing cash bail. They have weakened criminal statutes, allowing repeat convicted offenders to go back into the community and break the law again without serious repercussions. Their sanctuary policies have rolled out the welcome mat for illegal immigrants, literally providing taxpayer-funded [room and board](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-WhyKlG5wzQg5KGv5TYz8oJkKdCtzME9YCIvpy6bgYSped7wSsEYYK9CEw34ayN0jUk6YZrwwLE3_7xI0ssrAsm6szoykEak17lOkfHWHTBLJsCbqXSvuaAyIWCXUE937FJo3Ap3Ld9rLMhy5sPZX9LJYaaiQXih9khmn4a36B7Q7tErRle1TnEzKleV_yzzdWxom-cZ3ZdDKPhOGiOru4eNp-EFECTd0FqokIY69Kk_UX98UNojN2L_9HaVSuwZglgyOi_y4CkzMz0NMeRA96ybrYZR2oxO&c=eil7OvZ6OHHjxv2K0k7KdevvUlVpI-bj-CKc_4l3Dfwb-sIxN3WoIw==&ch=fvs8-ULIhAequ8Tzsa2Itp1JcmJ_t7jpV4tOMfzycuYLOUJkVcfP0w==) and [debit cards](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-WhyKlG5wzQg5KGv5TYz8oJkKdCtzME9YCIvpy6bgYSped7wSsEYYK9CEw34ayN0_rdTLPorXIBkMObhiE_RKIm-QXQhFDiAVWpTI9uDqGF9ncwchk8RQ5TF-vrdxUS6Xl4790Gaj70DrcWb86dQfOiPnBssovrFX5GGp7OUGNwW_-5JxBEts-dUi2LQ9uoFfkVsceeg2onUgExeVYYdjR_MaxujlldmOdEtv6j5xsV3jawrFwqchncK7dKEB6umnUcK3KppCwJgY0J2P1Q1Gw==&c=eil7OvZ6OHHjxv2K0k7KdevvUlVpI-bj-CKc_4l3Dfwb-sIxN3WoIw==&ch=fvs8-ULIhAequ8Tzsa2Itp1JcmJ_t7jpV4tOMfzycuYLOUJkVcfP0w==) free of charge. They ignore the verdict rendered by the voters of our state, rushing into legislative chambers to enact laws on items that were previously rejected in public referendums. They even thumb their nose at the courts, rejecting court-ordered nonpartisan congressional-district boundaries in favor of attempting -- for the second time in as many years -- to set up gerrymandered districts that would make political bosses in the smoke-filled rooms of yore blush.
Democrats in New York should be pushing for laws that strengthen and secure elections; instead they are trying to give away our right to vote -- a right that's sacred to our republic. I have a bill introduced in the state senate, [S. B. S3625](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-WhyKlG5wzQg5KGv5TYz8oJkKdCtzME9YCIvpy6bgYSped7wSsEYYK9CEw34ayN0wawZu6b85c8HdfUHWIXUTbQuLGK3nJ3moeBzwXWEXVjA3ypgZeuy1_76WKwWTylc-yjLMmVP9cQz4jfFcKop3DImM-SQ1mDoLrr4vKC50pqeRuFG0XI1YHU6EZi9xBLS&c=eil7OvZ6OHHjxv2K0k7KdevvUlVpI-bj-CKc_4l3Dfwb-sIxN3WoIw==&ch=fvs8-ULIhAequ8Tzsa2Itp1JcmJ_t7jpV4tOMfzycuYLOUJkVcfP0w==), that would require voters to present a valid government ID when voting. The bill contains a provision to waive fees to ensure that economically disadvantaged individuals can secure IDs if needed. Essentially, it will confirm the identity of the citizen casting a vote.
Left-wing Democrats in New York and elsewhere are following a troubling playbook. Under the guise of being enlightened and all-inclusive, they are pushing to guarantee their political survival as their policies become increasingly unpalatable for decent, law-abiding people. They want absolute power and have already embraced corrupt methods to attain it.
What just played out in the courtrooms of New York State is a cautionary tale for the entire country. The court got this one right, and thankfully, our system worked. But as Democrats continue attempting to rig that very system, we must seriously confront the reality that next time we may not be so lucky.

I can’t explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it – there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

| |

| | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

**With that being said, could you do me the simple favor of just reading this all the way through to the end?** If you get to the end and still don't think you have the power to make a difference, then I just want to thank you for your time.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.

**I 'm trying to restore America to the time when it wasn't unusual that a factory worker and a bartender could afford a home. _Democrats hope I give up on you and stop sending these emails.

They also hope you stop reading these emails.

They'd love it if we both give up on our conservative values altogether._

_**I won 't give up on you, and I hope you won't quit on me or our shared values either.**_ I know a lot of folks are going to ignore this, but I need patriots like you to see what's at stake. subject: Socialism vs. Free-Market Capitalism
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWAZ0pMiNW

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWAZ0pMiNW

The
debate about socialism and free-market capitalism is growing
louder across the globe.

While
proponents of capitalism celebrate the economic growth that is
created by private enterprise and individual freedom, advocates
of socialism claim they have a more compassionate system because
of its egalitarian nature.

But which
one has a more positive effect on human flourishing?

To answer
this question, the Hoover Institution gathered a
multi-disciplinary group of its world-renowned scholars to
investigate the historical record and assess the outcomes of both
systems.

And the
results are eye-opening.

From what
I'm told, you are someone who would be interested in hearing
these results, and that's why I'm emailing you today.

We
recently launched a new two-part online course called Socialism
and Free-Market Capitalism: History and Outcomes to outline the
findings of the project. And I want to invite you to take it for
FREE as my guest.

Inside
these 7 lessons you'll discover:

Why
communism failed and liberal democracy prosperedWhy political
freedom and prosperity go hand in handHow nations in the
Indo-Pacific region view China and why many are seeking their own
paths between socialism and capitalism.
You can
activate your free online course right now by using this secure
link: https://resources.hoover.org/hp-history-and-outcomes-signup

When you
do, you'll receive Lesson 1 by email within minutes. Subsequent
lessons will be emailed to you every 5 days until the course is
completed.

Please
use this link to get instant access to your free online course
today!

Thank
you,
Greg

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/International%20Women%27s%20Day.png]
Today is International Women’s Day! We’d like to highlight the important Paid Family and Medical Leave legislation from this session.
The lack of access to Paid Family and Medical Leave is something that disproportionately affects women in Virginia and across the United States. Black women in particular are the most negatively impacted. It’s estimated that Black women in the USA lose $3.9 billion in wages each year due to unpaid leave.
We’re thankful that Senator Jennifer Boysko and Delegate Briana Sewell recognized the issue of unpaid leave in Virginia and carried legislation to establish a Paid Family and Medical Leave insurance program. This International Women’s Day we’re celebrating women across Virginia by advocating for Paid Family and Medical Leave to become law!

clean_body: [] Today is International Women’s Day! We’d like to highlight the important Paid Family and Medical Leave legislation from this session. The lack of access to Paid Family and Medical Leave is something that disproportionately affects women in Virginia and across the United States. Black women in particular are the most negatively impacted. It’s estimated that Black women in the USA lose $3.9 billion in wages each year due to unpaid leave. We’re thankful that Senator Jennifer Boysko and Delegate Briana Sewell recognized the issue of unpaid leave in Virginia and carried legislation to establish a Paid Family and Medical Leave insurance program. This International Women’s Day we’re celebrating women across Virginia by advocating for Paid Family and Medical Leave to become law! Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots. I think that anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
#

I won’t ever forget it, Peter.
Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.
I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.
And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick.
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.
I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.
I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.

body:
Women like my grandmother, my mother, and my sisters shaped who I am today.
| | |
---
Friend,

I'm only where I am today thanks to the generations of strong women who paved my path — ** so in honor of International Women's Day, I'd like to share how they've inspired me to run for Florida's Senate seat. **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80555167/459709134/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk904-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGY0ZmJkZWUtNWRkZC1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=X4QL6qTQymYlzDLgOUgwG0o69rI4mPB5RnstCSo9cEk=)
While my mother worked full-time to provide for my sisters and me — _a pretty uncommon path for women in Ecuador then_ — my grandmother would help out by coming over to cook. She was resilient, caring, and there for us when we needed her most.
**She passed down that loving strength from generation to generation, including to my mother, who made the tough but incredibly brave decision to bring my sisters and me to America when I was 14.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80555168/459709135/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk904-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGY0ZmJkZWUtNWRkZC1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=X4QL6qTQymYlzDLgOUgwG0o69rI4mPB5RnstCSo9cEk=)
My mother worked so hard during those first days in America, working double-shifts back-to-back and taking English classes at night, all to give us a shot at a better life. I did everything I could to pitch in and help her make ends meet.
And when I faced any sort of difficulty or hardship, my older sisters were always ready to stand up for me. **By watching them, I learned how to stand up for myself.**
Women like my grandmother, my mother, and my sisters shaped who I am today. Their sacrifices, strength, and courage are why I was able to go to college, begin a career in giving back to my own community, and eventually become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress.
**_In short, they're the reason I was able to achieve my American Dream._ **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80555169/459709136/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk904-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGY0ZmJkZWUtNWRkZC1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=X4QL6qTQymYlzDLgOUgwG0o69rI4mPB5RnstCSo9cEk=)
Now I'm raising my girls to have the same strength, courage, and resolve those women passed to me — **but sometimes, I'm afraid it won't be enough to overcome the growing barriers to the American Dream that I never had to face.**
Today, it's so much harder to pay for a college education, get a good job, or afford a home. And at the same time, we're facing unrelenting attacks on reproductive rights, which have left my daughters with almost zero bodily autonomy and fewer freedoms than I had at their age.
That's why I'm running for Senate:**to ensure the next generation of women, and everyone, can have the freedoms and opportunities to achieve the American Dream my family came here to find**. But, friend, in a race this competitive, I can't make that happen without you.
Recent polls show my race to unseat Rick Scott is neck and neck — **but more than that, I can see with my own eyes that Florida is ready for something new. Florida is ready for a leader who will fight for their fundamental rights. Florida is ready for a leader who will deliver. Florida is ready for progress.[So if you're ready for a strong Latina to lead Florida into a future where the American Dream is within reach, will you please donate $5, or anything you can spare, to help me win this race and fight for our future in the Senate?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80555170/459709137/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk904-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGY0ZmJkZWUtNWRkZC1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=X4QL6qTQymYlzDLgOUgwG0o69rI4mPB5RnstCSo9cEk=) **

clean_body: Women like my grandmother, my mother, and my sisters shaped who I am today. | | | Friend, I'm only where I am today thanks to the generations of strong women who paved my path — so in honor of International Women's Day, I'd like to share how they've inspired me to run for Florida's Senate seat. = While my mother worked full-time to provide for my sisters and me — a pretty uncommon path for women in Ecuador then — my grandmother would help out by coming over to cook. She was resilient, caring, and there for us when we needed her most. She passed down that loving strength from generation to generation, including to my mother, who made the tough but incredibly brave decision to bring my sisters and me to America when I was 14. = My mother worked so hard during those first days in America, working double-shifts back-to-back and taking English classes at night, all to give us a shot at a better life. I did everything I could to pitch in and help her make ends meet. And when I faced any sort of difficulty or hardship, my older sisters were always ready to stand up for me. By watching them, I learned how to stand up for myself. Women like my grandmother, my mother, and my sisters shaped who I am today. Their sacrifices, strength, and courage are why I was able to go to college, begin a career in giving back to my own community, and eventually become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. In short, they're the reason I was able to achieve my American Dream. = Now I'm raising my girls to have the same strength, courage, and resolve those women passed to me — but sometimes, I'm afraid it won't be enough to overcome the growing barriers to the American Dream that I never had to face. Today, it's so much harder to pay for a college education, get a good job, or afford a home. And at the same time, we're facing unrelenting attacks on reproductive rights, which have left my daughters with almost zero bodily autonomy and fewer freedoms than I had at their age. That's why I'm running for Senate:to ensure the next generation of women, and everyone, can have the freedoms and opportunities to achieve the American Dream my family came here to find. But, friend, in a race this competitive, I can't make that happen without you. Recent polls show my race to unseat Rick Scott is neck and neck — but more than that, I can see with my own eyes that Florida is ready for something new. body:
President Biden knows that fighting to end gun violence is the right thing to do.
#

Friends -
Last night, I was proud to watch my friend President Joe Biden use his State of the Union address to bring attention to the triumphs and challenges we have faced together in our movement for gun safety.
During his decades spent in office, Joe Biden has fought tirelessly for gun safety. I’m so proud to have him with us in our movement to end our nation’s gun violence epidemic.
[**With just eight months until Election Day, there is no time to waste. Please, make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to help us in the crucial fight to reelect Joe Biden this November.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240308-1-30&t=1&akid=7732%2E3935704%2EFvi20X)
President Biden knows that fighting to end gun violence is the right thing to do. Throughout his time in public office, he has consoled families of shooting victims, and he’s comforted survivors grieving the loss of a child, parent, or spouse. I experienced this comfort firsthand when he stood by my side during the darkest days of my recovery.
President Biden is a trustworthy leader who backs up his words and promises with policy and change. In 2022, he signed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act into law—the most significant package of gun safety legislation enacted in nearly three decades. Under President Biden, the ATF regulated ghost guns and stabilizing pistol braces. He also signed important executive actions to expand background checks, extreme risk protection orders (aka red flag laws), and safe storage.
[**Another four years of President Biden in office will bring another four years of unprecedented progress for our movement. Can I count on you to contribute $3 or more to GIFFORDS PAC today to help us make sure we have the resources to reelect President Biden in November?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240308-1-30&t=2&akid=7732%2E3935704%2EFvi20X)

| Peter - On Monday, I officially filed my candidacy for Nevada’s 3rd congressional district with my wife Sarah at my side.

Since launching our campaign in May 2023, our team has worked tirelessly to **spread our message of limited government, fiscal responsibility, and border security** across the district.
---
|
---
| I have spent my career in conservative think tanks, grassroots nonprofits, and the media.

I have helped** save taxpayers more than $60 billion, drafted legislation empowering thousands of students to attend better schools, and eliminated burdensome licensing barriers on small business owners.**

Failed politicians like Joe Biden and Susie Lee have spiked inflation by supporting reckless spending, increasing taxes, and restricting our domestic energy supply. **They have refused to secure our southern border, leading to an unprecedented humanitarian crisis.** These failures have real consequences: Nevadans are struggling to get by, dangerous criminals make us fear for our safety, and deadly drugs like fentanyl are pouring into our communities at an alarming rate.

My opponent, **Susie Lee, votes with Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden 99% of the time**. She seems more interested in [making millions of dollars from unreported, shady insider stock trades](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=4de41c9b00&e=fc26432468) than doing what she was elected to do: helping the good people of CD3.

I was raised by a struggling single mom, lived in my car while starting an innovative nonprofit, and made my career as a government watchdog, getting corrupt politicians like Susie Lee thrown out of office.

When elected, **I’ll use my decades of experience as a commonsense policy leader to create sensible solutions to immigration, inflation, and runaway government spending, while rooting out public corruption**. It’s what the people of Southern Nevada deserve.

I invite you to be part of our movement to unite our community behind our shared belief in individual liberty, personal responsibility, and the American Dream.
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | | [](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=61a187852b&e=fc26432468)

As always, thank you for your [continued support of our campaign!](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=a359a4a22c&e=fc26432468) No matter the amount -- whether it's $5, $50, or $5,000 -- every dollar makes a difference!
---
|
---
|
# _**On the Campaign Trail**_
Drew and Sarah enjoyed seeing old friends and meeting new supporters at the wonderful **Sun City Summerlin** Coffee and Conversations event hosted by Cathy and Jim. Drew listened to the concerns of Sun City Summerlin voters and shared his plan to protect Social Security and lower costs for seniors.
---
|
---
|
---
| **Siena** community conservative leaders Brooke and Louise hosted a fundraiser/meet and greet for Drew. More than 60 Siena residents packed the event to hear how Drew will bring decency and innovative solutions to Capitol Hill.

Drew shared his inspiring background, answered questions, and learned about the issues facing his future constituents.
---
|
---
|
---
| The **Nevada Republican Club** held a debate on March 5th between the top-2 Republican candidates for Nevada's 3rd congressional district. Attendees overwhelmingly agreed that Drew won the debate and supported his vision to strengthen the border, tackle the debt, and fight to get Nevada its fair share of water.

The crowd soured on Drew's opponent, Dan Schwartz, when Schwartz pledged unlimited tax dollars for Ukraine, yelled at a woman in the crowd for shaking her head in disagreement with one of his answers, and admitted he didn't even live in the 3rd congressional district.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
# _**Upcoming Events**_
---
|
### TONIGHT! March 8 | 6:30 PM
Don't miss your chance to hear Drew speak at the S.T.A.N.D. event _tonight_ at the **Four Seasons Church**. It'll be a great night of food and fellowship with several major candidates and faith leaders in our community. [**Learn more. **](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=489d096754&e=fc26432468)

|
### March 12 | 6 - 8 PM
The **Sin City Chamber of Commerce** will host Drew at the beautiful Ahern Hotel from 6 to 8 PM on March 12. This will be a great opportunity to mingle with small business leaders and chat with Drew about how he hopes to make it easier to do business in Southern Nevada!
---
|
---
|
---
|
### March 26 | 11 AM - 1 PM
Catch Drew in action! On March 26, he'll participate in the **Southern Hills Republican Women's Congressional Town Hall.** Learn more about the event [here](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=b7dd83647f&e=fc26432468).
---
|
---
|
# _**Endorsement Alert**_
---
|
---
| Drew has earned the support of **Congressman Mark Alford** of Missouri's 4th district. Congressman Alford has been a leader in government transparency, protecting our veterans, securing our borders, and defending the Second Amendment. We are proud to have his support.
---
|
---
|
---
|
# _YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!_
Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the **_TOP 3_ ways _YOU_ can get involved:**

1. **Donate: **Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a _huge_ difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! **You can contribute to the campaign [HERE](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=7b10a23e63&e=fc26432468)**.

2. **Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew** : Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the _best ways to spread our message_. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or an energetic Golden Knights watch party, we can make hosting a get-together fun and easy. Interested in hosting a Meet-and-Greet? Email [linnea@drewfornevada.com](mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!).

3. **Volunteer for the Campaign:** #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit** **[THIS](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=b6fabf895c&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

Drew listened to the concerns of Sun City Summerlin voters and shared his plan to protect Social Security and lower costs for seniors. | | | Siena community conservative leaders Brooke and Louise hosted a fundraiser/meet and greet for Drew. More than 60 Siena residents packed the event to hear how Drew will bring decency and innovative solutions to Capitol Hill. Drew shared his inspiring background, answered questions, and learned about the issues facing his future constituents. | | | The Nevada Republican Club held a debate on March 5th between the top-2 Republican candidates for Nevada's 3rd congressional district. Attendees overwhelmingly agreed that Drew won the debate and supported his vision to strengthen the border, tackle the debt, and fight to get Nevada its fair share of water. Hello...

This could be the last email I send you this year, Friend.

But I have to be honest with you -- no matter how weary I am about opening up.

**As we head into Election Year, the odds are stacked against us, and I need to know how you 'll react to this email to understand how to move forward. Your response could change everything. We missed our most recent fundraising deadline, and if we keep missing these, my campaign could be done.**

My name is Jim Banks. If you haven't heard of me, I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress.

name: Aruna Miller
subject: Women’s History Month
body:
Friend,

Maryland's rich history is filled with remarkable women who have blazed trails and shattered glass ceilings. From pioneers in science and technology to leaders in politics and the arts, Maryland women show us that anything is possible when you dream.

As a daughter of immigrants, I have dedicated my life to public service and removing systemic barriers to opportunity. As a mother of three daughters, I want to ensure they have every opportunity to succeed. As Maryland’s Lt. Governor — and the first woman of color to hold this office — I am dedicated to supporting policies that support all women and create a more equitable future.

This month, I want to honor the long legacy of trailblazing women who have paved the path to today. These agents of change inspire us to open more doors for women of all backgrounds and identities, including more women who will dedicate their lives to public service.

Every day is a fight to create a more inclusive democracy, and I’m proud to be a part of that fight and this administration.

Happy Women’s History Month!

With gratitude,

Aruna Miller

Peter,
Last night, President Joe Biden laid out the facts.
**Companies are raking in record profits by exploiting hard-working Americans.**
From shrinking their products and pocketing the difference to raising prices on products at a faster rate than their production costs increase, these deceptive practices that I call shrinkflation and greedflation are driving up grocery bills and affecting families across the Nation.
I’m leading the fight to hold greedy corporations accountable. Last week, I introduced the Shrinkflation Prevention Act to crack down on corporations and put money back into the pockets of hard-working Americans. I’m also proud to support the Price Gouging Prevention Act to bring relief to consumers.
**[There’s still more to do. We know that Senator Menendez is unfit to serve New Jersey, that's why last year I was one of the first to call for Menendez to step down from the US Senate. Still, Senator Menendez keeps pushing back, continuing to refuse to step down when asked at the Capitol. = A new poll out this week shows that 74% of New Jersey voters disapprove of Bob Menendez's job performance and 63% of voters want him to resign right now. Our campaign is fighting for a better future for New Jersey – one that brings everyone into the conversation and includes every voice in our democracy. I am in this race to restore integrity back into our politics, show people that there are public servants who are trying to do the right work, put the people ahead of personal gain or ambition, and just be able to deliver for my state. I'm running to restore trust in our democracy and our elected officials because if we don't, we could lose this Senate seat. New Jerseyans are ready for change. We know this because our grassroots events are at max capacity and we hold a strong lead in the most recent polls. But that might not be enough. March 8, 2024

Dear Fellow Ohioans,

We are proud to endorse Matt Dolan for the United States Senate. America faces tremendous challenges, and it is more important than ever that we elect leaders who embody conservative values and principles and have a track record of getting things done.

The contest for the Republican nomination includes three candidates who are good people, who care deeply about our state. After much consideration, we feel that Matt Dolan's conservative record of accomplishment and his commitment to continue to focus on achieving results in the U.S. Senate set him apart.

Our party and our state have consistently looked to Matt as a leader, capable of working with others to achieve important policy wins for Ohio. From expanding school choice, to cutting taxes, protecting our natural resources, and implementing a pro-growth agenda, Matt's results-oriented focus makes him the candidate best suited to be successful in solving problems in the U.S. Senate, too. Problems like the crisis at our southern border and addressing out of control spending and unprecedented levels of debt and deficit.

Matt has used the platform of his campaign to outline concrete plans to address these problems, including his plans to secure our border, reduce inflation and the national debt, protect Ohio industry and workers, and stand up to the threats of foreign adversaries such as China and Russia.

We believe his deep understanding of the issues facing our state, combined with his ability to build consensus and drive meaningful change, make him the best choice to represent Ohioans at the federal level and champion the cause of freedom at home and abroad.

In the United States Senate one principled voice can truly make a difference. America needs more leaders willing to stand by the courage of their convictions. Ohio needs a Senator with a track record of conservative results. With so much at stake, we urge our fellow Ohioans to join us in voting for Matt Dolan.

Sincerely,

Friends –

Registering students where they are. | | | | | [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=4cf0593ec6&e=95417d7e87)
---
Fellow activist,

A critical part of our strategy is to increase youth voter turnout. That’s why we conduct voter registration blitzes and civic education, meeting students where they are – on their campuses.

During the weekend of March 16-17, we will hold a weekend voter registration blitz at Penn State University in Centre County, where we will be sending staff out to register students and ensuring they know what’s at stake during this year’s critical elections. Last year, we registered 420 students in one weekend.

But here’s the thing:

**We still need to raise $2,500 to pull this off.** This gap includes funding for staff, transportation, lodging, and materials to help students register to vote. **An angel investor has agreed to triple all donations that come in up to $1,500 from this email.** Without hitting that goal, we won’t be able to have a successful voter registration blitz.

[**To further our democracy, we must ensure that young people are informed, engaged, and ready to vote. Our goal is to raise $2,500 to register students at Penn State University, main campus. Will you rush $25 or more now to fund our youth voter registration campaign so we can register as many students as possible? →**](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=2e9e40a2dc&e=95417d7e87)

We will be showing up to speak directly to students, listen to what they have to say, and ensure they have the information they need to make their voices heard to vote their values at the ballot box. Youth empowerment is one of our top priorities, but to get this done, we need your help.

Are you an alumnus of the nearly 300 colleges, universities, or technical schools in Pennsylvania? Let us know where our team should go next!

In solidarity,

The New PA Project Education Fund

name: Rob Portman
subject: Rob Portman Endorses Matt Dolan for U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rob Portman for Senate
body:
We are proud to endorse Matt Dolan for the United States Senate. America faces
tremendous challenges, and it is more important than ever that we elect leaders
who embody conservative values and principles and have a track record of
getting things done.

March 8, 2024

Dear Fellow Ohioans,

We are proud to endorse Matt Dolan for the United States Senate. America faces
tremendous challenges, and it is more important than ever that we elect leaders
who embody conservative values and principles and have a track record of
getting things done.

The contest for the Republican nomination includes three candidates who are
good people, who care deeply about our state. After much consideration, we feel
that Matt Dolan’s conservative record of accomplishment and his commitment to
continue to focus on achieving results in the U.S. Senate set him apart.

Our party and our state have consistently looked to Matt as a leader, capable
of working with others to achieve important policy wins for Ohio. From
expanding school choice, to cutting taxes, protecting our natural resources,
and implementing a pro-growth agenda, Matt’s results-oriented focus makes him
the candidate best suited to be successful in solving problems in the U.S.
Senate, too. Problems like the crisis at our southern border and addressing out
of control spending and unprecedented levels of debt and deficit.

Matt has used the platform of his campaign to outline concrete plans to
address these problems, including his plans to secure our border, reduce
inflation and the national debt, protect Ohio industry and workers, and stand
up to the threats of foreign adversaries such as China and Russia.

We believe his deep understanding of the issues facing our state, combined
with his ability to build consensus and drive meaningful change, make him the
best choice to represent Ohioans at the federal level and champion the cause of
freedom at home and abroad.

In the United States Senate one principled voice can truly make a difference.
America needs more leaders willing to stand by the courage of their
convictions. Ohio needs a Senator with a track record of conservative results.
With so much at stake, we urge our fellow Ohioans to join us in voting for Matt
Dolan.

Sincerely,

Rob Portman

Jane Portman

subject: The team that will win in Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee
body:
One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me.

| Peter

, when I first thought about launching this campaign last year, I had no idea what to expect.

I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that, it was a shot in the dark.

One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.

And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.

I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.

subject: The NRA’s tax returns aren’t pretty

body:
Mark my words, friend : Gen Z will outlive the NRA.
The Daily Beast recently analyzed the NRA’s tax returns. They aren’t pretty.
In fact, the pro-gun group’s revenue has been on the decline for years now, especially since Parkland. Last year, their fundraising was at its lowest point since 2008. And since 2018 they have lost over 1 million members.
I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—and as their power and influence fade into the dustbin of history, we will replace their corrupt, purchased politicians with a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action to stop the scourge of gun violence in America.
I co-founded Leaders We Deserve because Gen Z’s answer to the NRA is electing more and more young people to public office to counter their agenda.
With so much riding on the upcoming elections, we’re preparing now so we can elect the leaders we deserve in November. Will you split a contribution to support Leaders We Deserve and Serve America today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
We founded Leaders We Deserve last year to elect the next generation of leadership—and folks across the country are already helping us shatter expectations.
Not only have tens of thousands of people just like you joined our movement and helped spread the word about our mission, we’ve already elected our very first candidate.
In the days leading up to the November election, we hit the streets in Virginia to knock on doors and get out the vote for Nadarius Clark. Thanks to our supporters’ donations, we were proud to invest more than $100,000 to support Nadarius’s campaign.
When all the ballots were counted, Nadarius won by less than 2,000 votes.
Leaders We Deserve is already playing an integral role in electing the next generation of leaders and we’re counting on your continued support so we can keep winning these fights in 2024. There is too much on the line for us to lose.
Leaders We Deserve and Serve America can only be successful in November with your continued support, so can you split a contribution or whatever makes sense for you today? Anything you can give will make a difference. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Thank you for your consideration,
David Hogg
Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

We just took a huge risk to go up with our first TV ads of this election... The money wasn’t in the budget, but our whole team agreed: We have to do everything we possibly can to defeat right-wing megamillionaire Eric Hovde and send Tammy back to the Senate so she can keep fighting for all of us. Please read Tammy’s message so you know why we had to make this difficult decision — **[and then chip in, if you can.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-mar24.lt590f&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240308_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2184%2E35263%2E1duKim)** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Tammy Baldwin
Date: Thu, Mar 7, 2024
Subject: Tough call Within one week of announcing his campaign, my Republican opponent launched $2.5+ million worth of TV and digital ads to blanket Wisconsin and attempt to control the narrative in our race. For weeks, Eric Hovde has had the airwaves to himself — putting our campaign in a difficult position. **That’s why my campaign manager just gave the green light to increase our advertising budget for the month so we could launch our own TV and digital ads right away.** This was a tough decision to make. I know it carries a pretty big risk. But we didn’t anticipate these so-called “ad wars” beginning so soon, and we certainly didn’t expect Hovde to dump buckets of money into the race _this_ early. Look, TV ads aren’t cheap — they’re one of the most expensive line items on any campaign’s budget, but they’re also one of the most effective ways to win an election. That’s why I’m telling you all of this. The decision may have blown a hole in the budget, but I felt confident taking the risk because this grassroots team has always had my back. My hope is that I can count on you right now. **[Will you rush a donation to help our campaign close this unexpected budget gap so we can keep our ads up for as long as possible? My Democratic opponent Bob Ferguson will be a rubber stamp for every tax proposal brought to the Legislature.**I have demonstrated once again that I'm willing to push back against my own party when I see tax proposals that I know the average family can't afford.** This session we saw that with an attempt to remove the 1% property tax cap. _I can't find a single homeowner in Washington who feels their property taxes are too low._ This was the wrong time to raise property taxes, and I was the only Democratic on the Senate Ways & Means committee to vote against this proposal. But let's be clear, this same proposal will pass next year unless we have a Governor who is willing to veto unnecessary tax increases that are making our state unaffordable for working families.
We saw a similar dynamic around the initiative to allow police to pursue criminals who try to run away from them. I was the first Democrat in the Legislature to come out in support of this initiative and led the charge to have the Legislature sign this initiative into law this session. My Democratic opponent Bob Ferguson refuses to support commonsense initiatives like this police pursuit law. **That is why law enforcement organizations have endorsed my campaign for Governor.**
Throughout my public service, I have been a strong champion for the values of our state, but I have also worked hard to prevent overreach when I thought the right or the left was going too far. **I have worked to have a pragmatic, results-oriented approach that you would expect from a small business owner.** This approach makes sure state government works for as many people as possible while keeping the tax burden at a level that working families can afford.
**[I’m excited about the opportunity to bring that approach as your next Governor. I can’t do this without your help. The fundraising freeze that affects all state elected officials ended today. This session we saw that with an attempt to remove the 1% property tax cap. I can't find a single homeowner in Washington who feels their property taxes are too low. This was the wrong time to raise property taxes, and I was the only Democratic on the Senate Ways & Means committee to vote against this proposal. But let's be clear, this same proposal will pass next year unless we have a Governor who is willing to veto unnecessary tax increases that are making our state unaffordable for working families. I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.

# SATURDAY IS THE
# LAST DAY OF SESSION
---
| Friends, Saturday is the last day of session, which begins at 2pm. There are a number of bills still in conference that must be dealt with before legislators can adjourn, including the biennial budget, which looks nothing like the budget Governor Youngkin submitted.
There are roughly 100 bills already sitting on Governor Youngkin's desk that require action before midnight, Friday, March 8. These are bills that were signed by both House Speaker and Senate President before last Friday.
Many bills under the accelerated timeline address top issues such as gun control legislation, reproductive rights and raising the state's minimum wage floor.
Among the so-called seven-day bills:
* Banning legacy university admissions,
* Re-enrolling in a program to share voter information with other states,
* Requiring health insurance cover contraception.

Saturday is the last day to finish all of the bills currently in the Virginia Senate. All bills are in conference at this point, meaning a handful of senators and delegates will hash out any differences in the remaining bills and then make recommendations to the full Senate to accept or reject amendments made on the remaining bills.
On Saturday, the Senate will vote on the final budget that has been hashed out by Senate and House conferees. The budget was presented on Thursday to legislators and by law, they have 48 hours to review the budget. On Saturday, legislators will vote up or down on the budget.
in the biennial budget, teachers, state employees and state-supported local employees would receive raises of 3% in each year of the new two-year budget under an agreement that General Assembly budget negotiators unveiled on Thursday, March 7.
The revised assembly budget for the current fiscal year does not include budget language to finance a $2 billion professional sports and entertainment district in Alexandria, an exclusion that Governor Glenn Youngkin called a "colossal mistake."

Going forward, once lawmakers send the governor a budget, he could pursue an amendment and restore the language in the budget, or he could call a special session.
Legislators could also reject the budget bill and send it back to the conference committee for further consideration.

body:
My fellow Americans – this is Katie Britt.

| |

---
| | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zod6mvqdn9nt1smnh4hrtbdslnu4ij5asd3380jg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sjgm0or4cph2bs "Katie Britt")
---

My fellow Americans - this is Katie Britt.

**I just gave the official GOP response to Joe Biden 's State of the Union address.**
---
| | | [READ MY FULL UPDATE](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zaligh4tuh1malvdu6u1grk0sff7erii6seks5jo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sjgm0or4cph2bs "READ MY FULL UPDATE")
---
If today is the first time hearing my name, I get it. I was elected in 2022 as the youngest Republican woman ever elected to the Senate - and I'm honored to have just given the formal GOP response to the oldest president in the history of our country.

Look - the American People are rejecting Joe Biden not only because he's unfit for office, but for his radical ideology that is destroying America as we know it.

We're seeing a surge of violent crimes at the hands of illegal immigrants...

We're seeing our economy bottom out...

We're seeing the cost-of-living skyrocket out of control...

We're seeing Chinese-made fentanyl kill our young people...

We're seeing government weaponized against political opponents...

**And the buck stops with Joseph R. Biden.** So my message for you now is this: We can either complain about it or do something about it. My mind is made up. What about yours?

_**[I just addressed the American People so now I'm respectfully asking you to join me in helping REPLACE Joe Biden with a true leader like President Trump, SAVE our Conservative House Majority, and WIN BACK the Senate for the next generation.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zd5pl2d22e0r50nqredb80gu962qnpkjoma9csco_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sjgm0or4cph2bs "I just addressed the American People so now I’m respectfully asking you to join me in helping REPLACE Joe Biden with a true leader like President Trump, SAVE our Conservative House Majority, and WIN BACK the Senate for the next generation.")**_

The power is in your hands right now.

If we all stick together and dig deep right now, we'll send the Biden agenda into the ash heap of history where it belongs.

I just formally put Joe Biden on notice. The American People won't forget what he's doing to our country. Please stand with me now.
---
| | | [STAND WITH ME](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zuc2v1di410nkainmu77pla1up94klht1pgoalgo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sjgm0or4cph2bs "STAND WITH ME")
---
I hope I made you proud.

God bless you,
Senator Katie Britt

After ranting about something called “social currency,” Rogan then argued that self-censorship is getting so out of hand that, by 2029, Americans could find themselves in a Soviet Union-era “gulag” as punishment if they call someone by the wrong pronoun.
😳
**That’s crazy, Peter, but here’s why we have to take Joe Rogan seriously:**
When he makes these kinds of false, hateful claims, millions are listening. His podcast is still #1 on Spotify, the platform that has the exclusive rights to his show.
The fear and anger that right-wing personalities like Rogan spread directly led to January 6th, COVID misinformation, and a 2022 FBI report that found an alarming rise in hate crimes against the LGBTQ+ community.
Unfortunately, rather than taking a firm stand, Spotify continues to platform Rogan’s hate and misinformation because it’s good for profits.
**That’s why COURIER exists, Peter.** Our journalists operate in newsrooms across ten battleground states, and they are dedicated to calling misinformation out and holding those who spread it accountable.

| SB 603 Priority Treatment Jailed Pregnant and Addicted Women Passes the House Appropriations Committee
---
|
---
| My bill SB 603, which will give incarcerated pregnant women preferential treatment for drug rehab programs, is now on the governors desk. I have visited the women's jail in Goochland County and I've heard reports around the district about the challenges faced by pregnant women in jail to attend drug rehab programs. Incarcerated pregnant women (those held in federal or state prisons, jails, or juvenile detention facilities) make up one of the most vulnerable segments of society, with higher rates of mental illness, drug addiction, and histories of trauma than incarcerated men. This bill will create a work group to find answers on how to help rehabilitate young and not so young women with the triple threat of being incarcerated, being pregnant, and being addicted.

In last night’s State of the Union address, President Biden came out strong in support of the issues that matter most to the people of New Jersey and across America — affordability, building up our economy, protecting the middle class, reproductive freedom, and more.

I applaud the President’s focus on affordability for hardworking families. Making sure that families across New Jersey can pay their bills, feed their families, and save some money are the very things I have been fighting for since day one, and am proud of the progress we have made.

Today – and every day – we have to do everything we can to make life more affordable for our middle-income, workers, families, and seniors around New Jersey. Initiatives like helping families pay for childcare and lowering taxes for small businesses and middle-class workers are the key to the success of Jersey families.

The SALT deduction, along with other key initiatives, will put money back in the pockets of Jersey’s middle-class families — those whom our workforce would not survive without.

The fight for the working families of New Jersey isn’t over. If you’d like to help me in my work fighting for our Jersey Values, you can click here to donate any amount. I’m so grateful to have you on our team. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2403?amount=]

DONATE HERE > > [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2403?amount=]

Thank you,

Josh

clean_body: | | | | Peter — I want to introduce you to Carmen Rubio. She is a commissioner on the Portland City Council and is the only candidate for mayor who is a leading voice for change. = = We have all seen how Portland and the surrounding area have suffered in recent years — the rising cost of living, growing homelessness caused by unaffordable housing, public safety concerns, and the effects of climate change — but this is our chance to build a better future for all of us, and it all starts with Carmen. = It's true: Portland is facing historic problems. To some, this means Portland should shy away from its values, but this is not the time to be shy. Portland needs a mayor who will stand by our communities, leading with and for all. Carmen is the only person in the race who can do just that. She has served our community for decades, first in local government and then as the Executive Director of the Latino Network for more than a decade. She fought tooth and nail to swiftly bring down barriers to developing more housing in Portland through her work with the city Planning Bureau. Through it all, she developed our community, served our friends and families, and brought change to countless lives. Her experience and leadership have driven our community forward and will lead Portland towards the solutions we desperately need. A recap of President Biden's State of the Union address | |
---
| | [ ](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=34454ead9c&e=4d37f34e0f)
---
| | Hi Peter,

Like a lot of folks, I tuned in to President Biden's State of the Union Address last night. If you missed it, here's a quick recap:

**1️⃣ President Biden directly called out those who've downplayed the seriousness of the Capitol riots on January 6 – including Trump!

2️⃣ He called on Republicans to protect our right to our own family-planning choices, demanding that they "guarantee the right to IVF nationwide."

3️⃣ He urged Congress to pass an assault weapons and high-capacity magazine ban, while also requiring universal background checks when purchasing a gun.**

I'm happy to see the President continue to prioritize a people-first agenda, and as someone who hopes to be a strong voice for the American people in Congress, I'm glad to see that we're fighting for similar things.

But besides these issues, I'm running in Southeast Michigan to prioritize our kids' safety.

My son was a freshman in high school when a shooter opened fire and killed 4 of his classmates. And while things have been done here in Michigan to prevent tragedies like this one from happening again, we've yet to see any real progress be made in Congress.

_**That could all change this year.**_ My team and I are working hard to flip this district from red to blue and unseat extremist John James, who continues to sell his vote to the highest bidder.

But we can't do this alone. Moving forward, we're relying on the generosity of grassroots donors to connect with voters, share my story, and expand our budget for essential campaign materials – that's why your support is so important.

[**I'm reaching out personally to ask: will you join my team and support my pro-safety campaign for Congress with a donation of any amount you can spare? **](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=e7cc38e219&e=4d37f34e0f)

---
| Thank you,
Emily Busch

| | | Emily first learned the importance of community and helping others from her mom, a nurse, and dad, a manufacturing representative, while growing up in a tight-knit, middle-class Midwestern family.

The proud product of public schools, Emily worked hard in and out of the classroom, balancing her studies and interest in performing arts with an after-school job as a cashier at Ace Hardware. She went on to earn her B.A. in Biology from Indiana University and Masters from Michigan State University.

Now, Emily is running for Congress in Michigan’s 10th District to keep our kids safe, protect our rights, and lower costs for Michigan families.

Emily chose to move to Oakland County two decades ago because it was the place she wanted to raise her family – a place with friendly neighbors, good schools, and safe neighborhoods.

She and her husband, a retired firefighter and Marine, enjoy camping, fishing, and visiting national parks in their free time.

But besides these issues, I'm running in Southeast Michigan to prioritize our kids' safety. My son was a freshman in high school when a shooter opened fire and killed 4 of his classmates. And while things have been done here in Michigan to prevent tragedies like this one from happening again, we've yet to see any real progress be made in Congress. That could all change this year. My team and I are working hard to flip this district from red to blue and unseat extremist John James, who continues to sell his vote to the highest bidder. But we can't do this alone. Moving forward, we're relying on the generosity of grassroots donors to connect with voters, share my story, and expand our budget for essential campaign materials – that's why your support is so important. | "DONATE TODAY" | Thank you, Emily Busch | | | Emily first learned the importance of community and helping others from her mom, a nurse, and dad, a manufacturing representative, while growing up in a tight-knit, middle-class Midwestern family. The proud product of public schools, Emily worked hard in and out of the classroom, balancing her studies and interest in performing arts with an after-school job as a cashier at Ace Hardware. She went on to earn her B.A. in Biology from Indiana University and Masters from Michigan State University. Now, Emily is running for Congress in Michigan’s 10th District to keep our kids safe, protect our rights, and lower costs for Michigan families. Emily chose to move to Oakland County two decades ago because it was the place she wanted to raise her family – a place with friendly neighbors, good schools, and safe neighborhoods. She and her husband, a retired firefighter and Marine, enjoy camping, fishing, and visiting national parks in their free time. Prefer to donate via mail? Fellow American,

Tonight, we heard President Biden deliver his State of the Union address. Joe Biden has tried time and time again to address the challenges facing our nation but continues to fail. **The State of Our Union is bleak, but this November is our chance to restore the America First agenda.**

We need to elect leaders who put our country first. Leaders that will secure the border to keep Americans and our communities safe. Those who will fight to bring jobs back to America instead of sending them to China. Leaders who will bring our nation back to a position of power internationally.

**_As an America First congressman, my priority has always been to put the interests of our nation and its citizens above all else. However, the liberal policies implemented by President Biden and the lack of accountability do not align with this._**

body:

| | | **Empower and Celebrate: International Women 's Day****!**
---

Dear Peter,
Today, on International Women's Day, we stand in solidarity to celebrate the remarkable achievements of women in Washington’s 8th congressional district and around the globe. This day is not only a call to action for women's equality but also a celebration of the strides we have made towards achieving it.
Let’s honor and remember a few ladies who have paved the way on the international stage: Margaret Thatcher, the first female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom; Condoleezza Rice, the first African-American woman to serve as the United States Secretary of State; and Sandra Day O'Connor- the first woman to serve as a U.S. Supreme Court justice.

Our campaign is deeply committed to continuing this progress, advocating for policies that promote equality, support women’s health, and ensure economic opportunities for all women.

---
| | | |
---
|
But our work is far from done. We need your help to keep moving forward. A contribution of $25, $50, or $100 will help us:

* Support legislation that advances women’s rights and opportunities.
* Fund initiatives that empower women in our community through education and economic development.
* Ensure that women's voices are heard and valued in all aspects of society.

Carmen Goers

Join us for an evening to learn more about Save the Redwoods League and help us fulfill our mission to protect and restore California's iconic redwoods and connect all people to the joy and beauty of the forest.

This year's Take Me to the Trees event will feature internet sensation and park ranger Griff Griffith, special guests from the field, and live music from the tribute band Super Diamond.

Get ready to raise your paddle for redwood adventures and test your sequoia savvy with campy activities.

It all comes with delicious craft cocktails, drinks in the wine and beer garden, great food, and inspiring conversations—plus breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge.

I want to take a moment to share some of my thoughts with you about our progress under Biden and about the work that lies ahead. Under President Biden and our Democratic Senate majority, we’ve made historic progress for the American people. We lowered prescription drug costs and capped insulin for seniors on Medicare to $35 a month. We created 15 million jobs in just three years. We passed one of the most significant laws ever for veterans – the _PACT Act_ – helping millions of our men and women in uniform access the care they deserve after being exposed to burn pits and other toxins. We also took massive steps to tackle climate change, passing the _Inflation Reduction Act_ – our largest investment in climate policy ever in the United States. Biden signed our $1 trillion infrastructure bill into law, a major achievement for our work to repair the nation’s roads, bridges, railways, and more. In fact, my guests at last night’s address were small business owners from Louisa Co., who secured broadband for their business thanks to the infrastructure law. It was an honor to have them by my side. I was proud to see President Biden reiterate our nation’s commitment to democracy and share his vision for further economic growth and technological progress. I was heartened to hear him recommit his promise to restore _Roe_ and protect reproductive health care for women across the country. And I was reassured when he spoke on the urgent need to pass aid to Ukraine and renew American leadership on the global stage. But frankly, Derek, I know full well that these priorities are only possible if we elect Democrats around the country who are committed to these efforts. | | Friend, I’m sure by now you know how dangerous the filibuster is. Even if the majority of Americans support a piece of legislation, a small number of Senators—or even a single one—can prevent it from being passed. It’s just another way for a few Senators to override the will of the majority, and it’s wrong. Kyrsten Sinema is one of the biggest supporters of the filibuster, but she announced that she’s not running for re-election. This could be our chance to get rid of the filibuster once and for all! Republicans have used the filibuster to stop legislation on gun control, voting rights, and campaign finance transparency- all things that the majority of Americans are in favor of. **[The filibuster is a shameful reminder that our government still does not truly work for us. It’s time for the filibuster to go, and Kyrsten Sinema leaving the Senate is perfect timing for that to happen! If you want to see the end of the filibuster, please chip in $10 today so we can work together to push for the Senate reform that we desperately need.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80585350/459795116/-1167173318?refcode=3-8-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkYTMzYmVlLTgzZGQtZWUxMS04NWZiLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4abwjWQcifMDqC-SM4gKnGw5H63I4fOQxnYt3OrwQkk=)** In 2022, Kyrsten Sinema and Joe Manchin prevented the passage of crucial voting rights legislation in the Senate when they refused to change the filibuster rules to allow debate on it. This legislation would have ensured equal ballot access across the country, created an automatic voter registration system, and restored the gutted _Voting Rights Act_. It’s despicable that so few individuals can prevent passage of voting rights legislation that the majority of Americans are in favor of. **[Kyrsten Sinema and Joe Manchin leaving the Senate puts the future of the filibuster in jeopardy, and it’s time for us to make our move! The filibuster needs to go so power can be taken from a select few Senators and put back in the hands of the American people. So please, contribute $10 right now and we’ll keep working together to push for this much-needed Senate reform.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80585351/459795117/-1167173318?refcode=3-8-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkYTMzYmVlLTgzZGQtZWUxMS04NWZiLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4abwjWQcifMDqC-SM4gKnGw5H63I4fOQxnYt3OrwQkk=) ** Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action

Friend, This past weekend Donald Trump announced his endorsement of Congresswoman Lauren Boebert in her new Congressional District. This endorsement comes on the heels of an endorsement from GOP Speaker of the House Mike Johnson and a massive effort by the national GOP to throw a life preserver to Boebert’s fledgling campaign. Even with Trump and the GOP’s vein efforts to save her the outlook for Boebert is **_grim_** — while she is fending off (accurate) attacks that she is carpetbagging across Colorado and running in a district she has no ties to whatsoever,_she also has to fight off our legal challenge to expose her many actionable lies and deceptions_. In 2022 & 2023, **Boebert spent a whopping $85,000 defending herself from our defamation lawsuit** against her over her attacks on our PAC, staff, and donors, in which she claimed that information we released on her was fabricated. At the end of February the Judge in our case denied Boebert’s motion to dismiss the lawsuit paving the way forward for us to begin the discovery process where she will have to submit to a taped underoath deposition where she will face perjury charges if she lies. During this deposition we plan to ask her about her criminal past, financial dealings, involvement in Jan 6th, and more... Our lawsuit is now one of the many scandals and disasters dragging down her reelection prospects for 2024 and they continue to pile up ... i**t is only a matter of time until we see which straw will break the Boebert campaign’s back:**
---
|
---

I am so excited to be a partner with you on this team and wanted to take a minute to reach out and introduce myself:
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240308-3604-footer&t=1&akid=3604%2E420207%2ETZlgxT)
Hola Peter,
My name is Dalia Rodriguez, and I am the Outreach & Organizing Director for Team Pramila! I am so excited to be a partner with you on this team and wanted to take a minute to reach out and introduce myself:
I began organizing and mobilizing my neighbors in high school when my mentor ran for office and I helped him increase Hispanic voting turnout. To this day, what continues to motivate me has been being able to form that sense of community within different groups and reaching a common goal.
I was very excited when I saw that Team Pramila was hiring! Pramila is someone who I look up to and admire because of the way she gets things done and builds long-lasting relationships. I’m also impressed with the way she can work and understand all communities and become a vocal ally for them in DC.
**Each day, I am working to support the effort to re-elect Pramila to another term so she can continue the critical work she does as a vocal ally for all communities.[Today, will you pledge your support by making a $3 contribution to our campaign?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240308.Ma96kF&refcode=em20240308-3604&t=2&akid=3604%2E420207%2ETZlgxT)

I’m passionate about working to get more women elected. I have worked with U.S. Senator Smith (MN) and U.S. Senator Duckworth (IL) as well as various candidates from local to state levels. I have always prioritized engaging communities of color, labor unions, and issue advocacy organizations. I have also had the opportunity to mobilize city, suburban, and rural communities in Minnesota, Oregon, Illinois, and now Seattle.
In my free time, I enjoy helping my friends redecorate their homes or anything from yoga classes or dance classes to cooking classes. I also like to try new restaurants and coffee shops and am always looking for more suggestions and ways to support local businesses – especially here in Seattle!
I'm excited to build a home here in Seattle and create long-term mobilization within not only our campaign but the progressive movement overall. **Our work is more important than ever, Peter.**

* 25 U.S. senators, or 25% of 100 seats
* 151 congresswomen, or 28.2% of 535 seats
* 12 governors, or 24% of 50 seats
* 595 state senators, or 30.2% of 1,973 seats
* 417 mayors, or 25.8% of 1,616 seats

**This just doesn't sit right with us.** At every level down the ballot, women hold less than 50% of the available seats, and this significant lack of representation has translated into a lack of diverse perspectives shaping policies and driving progress. clean_body: Women hold less than 50% of the available seats in down-ballot offices. | | | | In honor of International Women's Day, it's time to talk about where we're at. According to the Center for American Women and Politics, these are how many female leaders we have in office: 25 U.S. senators, or 25% of 100 seats 151 congresswomen, or 28.2% of 535 seats 12 governors, or 24% of 50 seats 595 state senators, or 30.2% of 1,973 seats 417 mayors, or 25.8% of 1,616 seats This just doesn't sit right with us. At every level down the ballot, women hold less than 50% of the available seats, and this significant lack of representation has translated into a lack of diverse perspectives shaping policies and driving progress. So, that's why here at Movement Labs, we're doing something about it. We're recruiting and supporting female candidates down the ballot and helping to eliminate systemic barriers that hinder women's participation in politics. We know that there's so much work to be done, and the stakes could not be higher.
