| | ****Another Bumbling Biden SOTU 🙄****
---
| |
---
If you had an hour to waste last night, perhaps you tuned in to Biden’s State of the Union address. If you didn’t, consider yourself lucky. You didn’t need a crystal ball to see it coming, but the president’s rambling was riddled with both pipe dreams and flat-out lies. So where do I even begin? Let’s recap the utter absurdity:
* He boasted about reducing student debt, despite the fact that all of us as taxpayers will [foot the bill](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=14598fd9493e4d148f922d4edbe1bc75&_e=7-iQ3XpL5wNtAvKQJGssyzeTgznlysHd9L_dy4VaJpRoj0uHgFOk27y6HKc3pt3qkOOUG2y6xnexg477EQNVj2okhkSwjcveUv7qOAf_j-hsQp6CioeoyX3K2daj9xkCdNIAYOR1xKfcscSKE1nNiHYlKSZu8xXpBYFz3yQniJoQZMfPeIE9LmMzqHyMEEEACz2yyAkDiVdMyF7cjiPHKIABN_ssTGPEe0HsP1IjXquoULBCfjdsogCMJkOCfH0G7JVGehO52vmU-y5o5t_u4NNtVtw50dDwrkv6BvTUU_Y%3D) for years to come.
* He attempted to highlight his approach to the COVID-19 pandemic with a mantra about vaccines—the same ones he used to kick [8,000](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=14598fd9493e4d148f922d4edbe1bc75&_e=7-iQ3XpL5wNtAvKQJGssyyyX8nt_ZI_QPOYFxI7e3s3cO1-1G01RbC05nHeWS28P-jIQTUj88ztcRATZyxJ0iCx28moX0gl2TWHMnfML5KRJFK473wsK1z22RrEWENpwmkOxSYPTd454eMQXbJ4nrFtPoSryStC8VsANPU1Q40ZGWX-5QN_kjovwrj_w0wG2ezVrFCW972FyvkvoGoRp4ssuVUrTPt-WGC-xi2PjECpisMxKbFfczDwQEhj5Omtqy9RU4anIo39I_cZNmcYEqA%3D%3D) U.S. service members out of our military.
* He had the audacity to tout consumer confidence while Americans are digging deep into their pockets and spending more on food than they have in [three decades](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=14598fd9493e4d148f922d4edbe1bc75&_e=7-iQ3XpL5wNtAvKQJGssyyhvna0oWh8Fppw7TRmGmDgsMFFNcYrXbx2u1A0WR-lzBUGPjUuBdvnqyGqzt6DKj55Ia_jqYDHutxuIVipecvcOc4px71iiqqZ1F4L94bQg3tWtJC8dHaVATxjz62LkX8wn_YJH6Vstllv522r8nYDKZLq8OUIp96BLG7Mu2THJnRGSAHIJUuKd3Jc_u0hj5zaBKhtK1nlEJjNpZT6uBYQsaufWfltXVXs43RWP5qCTC4oJIzGSi1uksTCEI1W7NS9z3uNphagVWeZ958e01xzlK8yrjtmJsGulFlvZnqic).
* He casually mentioned the complete chaos at our southern border by passing the buck, [blaming Republicans](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=14598fd9493e4d148f922d4edbe1bc75&_e=7-iQ3XpL5wNtAvKQJGssy4MsQCN2OZZHyDquAAIkl4UpxfNha_Kcy4WzJAZUy4pKbkd1WQY1Bwt2tU60dwZ1NpVkvKC1CJAng0HiuAY69tHlp4CoeVbG1BlwwAWvphDIddUG5LJ9NH38-ZqHrotwU53qlHzmUOUiwuetkhU0pqg8yHyfN7nDfMen5HTIqeyHkg7yM-TX4yfxm88j7w2ZMN3WEmIcBxtSsN38fgmfkEbQEq72IL84WHTgD1RE6Z2GL9g9eRthNCn56cjwEieedZZE-NQK16qcTwpuIdh0_-b6F_RS7JlhaA7GRJz88e0R) for not falling for the sham of a bill that does nothing to keep our nation safe from millions of unchecked, illegal immigrants.
* He promised [more handouts](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=14598fd9493e4d148f922d4edbe1bc75&_e=7-iQ3XpL5wNtAvKQJGssyzsPWHeEYazlZw_n_BBGs-vD8uCeeliKcsDOFvE9i8fwAEYQ7PMJZfefnaW2UUetqZMQSfMDjnSZ74M6dWXIKg5jSQPuTN5JcmrPIVUVfalyPztdmyHspsSMPNjiDwZkGv3IwXJDr-rdi8yPLj6GZfWpRkKP8cRwaV4oXd1ykCzgfQ3nxcqsKac-SJV3YGDAt86tm8pchM1NVYsFe450FGFzOkyw66CVd00syqK0cf5FAX46ppL9p40eVBxPdWTpkhvjdOhMx47hHTUwJmzS3D8%3D) in the form of free cash to help folks pay their mortgages—another cost we simply can’t afford as our nation’s debt rises by [$1 trillion every 100 days](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=14598fd9493e4d148f922d4edbe1bc75&_e=7-iQ3XpL5wNtAvKQJGssyzEW3IUfzua2VFAatf64xuk0cFc2Y9YxNecUiqyihl3d9UHtFIe2r4UsmDV5FOez1SrF-7lvbG6opNyIqED2-vqUkWQIML1DztU5RCTlvFrjeDp56Oydk280kMeAAF7DzzvNBBLg9rRfPkBE16TwF_hKhu6WwuMdhv2ignwdOxrfLYE0WvvfIakxbLC_PmaVr0MIuAMJjjJxZkNSscmp3q14qxBATVizw6EoZoaFiLO-VvFpy0aPcoW7JQsFcZ1BxtarvnVOY60cEadX0c1TZr4O6q3RoTypD4fbWHe5M-u-).

I could go on, but you get the idea. Our president is living in a parallel universe more distant than wherever those UFOs come from. He drops promises without giving thought to the real consequences and paints a picture of prosperity that Americans simply aren’t experiencing right now. After watching Biden’s speech, I can confidently say the state of the union is VULNERABLE.

| | **SOTU Guest of Honor 🇺🇲**
---

| | My guest for the State of the Union address last night was [Shawn Ryan](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=14598fd9493e4d148f922d4edbe1bc75&_e=7-iQ3XpL5wNtAvKQJGssy45_xSFK7KGoyckbDfVDyIJKBysas9qexrO26Namaly1qIfYiHpRpLIYj9e-h5jxQ_dxmAHdiDq66FlEd-OhnpPmW5uNraOplS5mn0xAdRo4jLfFlIW3vFHDzKYI755gQB_wlRUj5_JvkvIiyRUDP2JCBOvD3LcEKx2G2ojl6G4r8cpshqeaQ-cg1rrFwunpe0cR0Yoqw4cskQT1Zf4NFFE%3D), former Navy SEAL and CIA contractor with 14 years of service across many different combat operations. But his service to our country didn’t stop after retirement. He now helps veterans and many others share important stories you won’t find in the mainstream media as host of “The Shawn Ryan Show.” In addition to helping veterans making the unfamiliar transition from service to civilian life, Shawn has raised more than $1 million through crowdfunding for veterans in need. It was truly an honor to have an American hero like Shawn join me in Washington for this occasion. May we all be inspired by, and continue to honor, the selfless commitment our veterans have made to this country.

If you didn’t, consider yourself lucky. You didn’t need a crystal ball to see it coming, but the president’s rambling was riddled with both pipe dreams and flat-out lies. So where do I even begin? Let’s recap the utter absurdity: He boasted about reducing student debt, despite the fact that all of us as taxpayers will for years to come. He attempted to highlight his approach to the COVID-19 pandemic with a mantra about vaccines—the same ones he used to kick U.S. service members out of our military. He had the audacity to tout consumer confidence while Americans are digging deep into their pockets and spending more on food than they have in . He casually mentioned the complete chaos at our southern border by passing the buck, for not falling for the sham of a bill that does nothing to keep our nation safe from millions of unchecked, illegal immigrants. He promised in the form of free cash to help folks pay their mortgages—another cost we simply can’t afford as our nation’s debt rises by -. I could go on, but you get the idea. Our president is living in a parallel universe more distant than wherever those UFOs come from. He drops promises without giving thought to the real consequences and paints a picture of prosperity that Americans simply aren’t experiencing right now. After watching Biden’s speech, I can confidently say the state of the union is VULNERABLE. | | | | | SOTU Guest of Honor 🇺🇲 | | My guest for the State of the Union address last night was , former Navy SEAL and CIA contractor with 14 years of service across many different combat operations. But his service to our country didn’t stop after retirement. He now helps veterans and many others share important stories you won’t find in the mainstream media as host of “The Shawn Ryan Show.” In addition to helping veterans making the unfamiliar transition from service to civilian life, Shawn has raised more than $1 million through crowdfunding for veterans in need. It was truly an honor to have an American hero like Shawn join me in Washington for this occasion. Peter,
Last year in Minnesota, with a paper-thin majority, we made significant progress to strengthen abortion rights, expand paid family leave, combat climate change, and protect our communities from gun violence.
Now, we must be bold with our progressive plans and keep working together to do even more for Minnesota families.
**We also need to be bold in calling out Republicans for their harmful actions.**
Let’s call it like it is: The GOP is the party of dysfunction that touts an extreme agenda that’s morally wrong. They want our freedoms to be the casualty of their cultural wars.
I won’t stand for it, and I hope you won’t either.
It’s my job as Chair of the DGA to take a leading role in electing Democrats to governor’s offices nationwide, either by reelecting Democratic governors or flipping governor seats from red to blue.
Currently, GOP governors—including MAGA extremists like Ron DeSantis of Florida and Greg Abbott of Texas—run 26 states, while Democratic governors head 24 states.
We have an opportunity to improve those numbers in 2024. Your grassroots support will enable us to take our winning ways in Minnesota to other states across the country.
[**Peter, we have to work together to get this done. | Peter,

Last night, we heard from President Biden in his State of the Union address, where he laid out his accomplishments and plans for the coming year before both sessions of Congress.

As is customary for members, I was honored to bring a special guest to the State of the Union – Christie Nicas, a parent from PA-07 who was able to start her family through in vitro fertilization (IVF). In my district and across the country, parents like Christie deserve the right to decide when and how they want to start their families.

Since the Dobbs decision, I knew that Republicans’ position that ‘life begins at conception’ would mean further restrictions beyond abortion bans. Long before the Alabama Supreme Court decided to virtually end in vitro fertilization in the state, I was at the forefront of the fight to protect reproductive freedom. I have been leading the charge in Congress to codify the right to IVF treatment through my “Access to Family Building Act.”

While Republican extremists continue to block bills like this, I’ll continue fighting to ensure that women and families across the country have access to fertility treatments to help them start and grow their families.

Now more than ever, we need to elect a pro-choice majority in the House, and that starts with protecting vulnerable seats like mine in PA-07. body:

| |
“Orange County families already rejected Scott Baugh for being dangerously extreme and out of touch, and he’s only gotten worse since then. A corrupt career politician, Baugh has a history of putting his own interests and corporate donors over the needs of working Orange County residents, and has faced 20 criminal charges – four of them felonies – for breaking campaign finance laws. That’s just one of the many reasons voters will once again reject Baugh’s extremism in 2024 – and instead send long-time Orange County champion, law professor, legislator, and pro-choice advocate Dave Min to Congress this November,” **said DCCC Chair Suzan DelBene.**

—

**For immediate release:** March 8, 2024
**Contact:** Dan Gottlieb // 516-477-7834
**The Case Against Scott Baugh**
After being rejected by the voters of California’s 47th Congressional District in 2022, Scott Baugh is back again – and he’s still dangerously extreme and out-of-touch for Orange County.

A career politician and alleged election manipulator, Baugh has spent years only looking out for himself and [under the thumb of extremist donors](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=662b42ad26&e=7017cc100e) and special interests instead of delivering for Southern California families. If elected to Congress, he’s already made it clear that [he’d support banning abortion](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d86e4882c7&e=7017cc100e) nationwide [without exceptions](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=643b29cbf8&e=7017cc100e), even in cases of rape, incest, or danger to a woman’s life, and [would not](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c7f8883270&e=7017cc100e) protect same-sex marriage. Instead, Baugh has committed to being another culture war conspirator in Washington D.C. and he’s already gotten off to a head start – incoherently stating[ the “war on wokeness” was more dangerous than 9/11 and World War II](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e85a869725&e=7017cc100e). We can’t trust right-wing extremists and conspiracy theorists like Scott Baugh to make our laws.

Fortunately, California’s 47th Congressional District has a better choice in Dave Min – long-time Orange County champion, first-generation Korean American, former business law professor, legislator, and pro-choice advocate – who genuinely understands the problems Southern California families are facing and has put in the work to bring about better solutions. During the financial crisis, Min fought to hold Wall Street accountable and to help stabilize our economy. During his time in the State Senate – where he represented 80% of CA-47 – Min shepherded 28 bills into law, including legislation enshrining abortion rights in the California Constitution, expanding protections for domestic violence survivors, banning gun sales on state property, and addressing the causes of our climate crisis.

With so much on the line, Min is ready to bring that career-long fight for Orange County families to the halls of Congress. In Congress, Dave Min will defend reproductive freedom nationwide, crack down on corporate price gouging, fight to lower health care costs, and always put Orange County taxpayers first. The residents of this district rejected corrupt, far-right politician Scott Baugh the last time he tried to fool them. This November, they’ll slam the door shut on his divisive, destructive, and dysfunctional brand of politics.
**BAUGH HAS ALWAYS LOOKED OUT FOR HIS POLITICAL CAREER, NO MATTER THE COST TO ORANGE COUNTY FAMILIES**
Scott Baugh has been embroiled in scandal after scandal and dragged Orange County voters through the mud with him. While Scott Baugh was Chair of the Orange County Republican Party, as many as [600 Orange County residents ](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=036f353702&e=7017cc100e)had their voter registration changed to Republican without their consent. The scandal led to 12 arrests.

Baugh was also [indicted on several criminal charges](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=73fd0fc5b3&e=7017cc100e) related to a shady scheme to manipulate his own election results. In 1996, Scott Baugh faced more than 20 criminal charges, including four felony charges, for violating campaign finance laws and [persuading another person to commit](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c6f4a991e3&e=7017cc100e) perjury. Baugh admitted to committing nine violations of the California Political Reform Act and was [forced to pay](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=66dc529a68&e=7017cc100e) tens of thousands of dollars in fines.

To make matters worse, he’s made clear that he wants to void Orange County’s votes if he does not like who they support. Baugh is a [founding chairman](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e634533099&e=7017cc100e) of an organization that attempted to [disenfranchise Californians](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=f679d91820&e=7017cc100e) and spread voting disinformation...even before the 2020 election. At a time when families are struggling, Orange County needs a champion in Congress – not another corrupt politician.
**BAUGH IS DANGEROUSLY EXTREME, ANTI-CHOICE, AND OUT-OF-TOUCH FOR SUBURBAN ORANGE COUNTY**
Scott Baugh's legacy of corruption and criminal election manipulation is only outdone by his dangerous agenda for California’s 47th district. Baugh has stated that he openly [opposes](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=a079795d54&e=7017cc100e) reproductive freedoms and abortion rights and, in his last failed run for office, he even [refused](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=374bdbea76&e=7017cc100e) to codify protections for the LGBTQ+ community.

Baugh has also openly [advocated for the repeal of the Affordable Care Act](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=04c194ea84&e=7017cc100e), which would result in over a million Californians losing their health insurance coverage and eliminate federal protections for individuals with pre-existing conditions. Baugh’s hateful, out-of-touch agenda won’t sit well with this suburban district.
**BAUGH PUTS FAR-RIGHT CONSPIRACY THEORIES OVER FINDING SOLUTIONS TO HELP FAMILIES GET AHEAD **
There’s a reason Scott Baugh is a favorite of far-right GOP Speaker [Mike Johnson](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=bd99076ef9&e=7017cc100e) – he’d help peddle his extreme agenda in Congress. Like [Speaker Johnson](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=a79c941088&e=7017cc100e), Baugh is [closely tied with religious extremists](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=b88bdf6d8e&e=7017cc100e); his campaigns have been repeatedly funded by dangerous anti-abortion and anti-LGBTQ+ donors.

Baugh has also made a name for himself by peddling dangerous conspiracy theories – [going as far as to claim that the “War on Wokeism”](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ffa649ed59&e=7017cc100e) was more dangerous than both 9/11 and WWII.
_**WHAT THEY’RE SAYING**_
**Los Angeles Times:** Endorsement: Dave Min should replace Katie Porter in the 47th Congressional District. [Los Angeles Times, [1/15/24](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=2c91d3a6f9&e=7017cc100e)]

**HuffPost:** California Republican Scott Baugh: ‘Wokism’ More Threatening Than WWII, 9/11. [HuffPost, [9/5/23](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=7fa4f28696&e=7017cc100e)]

_“Scott Baugh, a Republican attorney hoping to flip a Democratic-held U.S. House seat in Orange County, California, said that “wokism” is more threatening to the country than the Sept. 11, 2001, terrorist attacks, both world wars and the Civil War. Baugh, a former GOP leader in the California State Assembly, made the remarks while speaking in October to the International Christian Ambassadors Association, an ecumenical Christian nonprofit. “What’s the greatest threat to religious freedom? We were born in the Revolutionary War. We survived civil wars, World War II, World War I, a lot of wars, 9/11,” Baugh said in a video posted to YouTube in June. “None of those were that threatening to our country compared to the war that we’re fighting now. That war is about wokism and the lack of common sense.”_

**Orange County Register:**_ “When asked Wednesday about the [State] GOP proposal [to suspend California's gas tax for six months], State Sen. Dave Min, D-Irvine, signaled he's open to the idea. Min...said he's also tired of the ‘sky-high’ cost of living in California. ‘Any legislation that helps ease the burden on taxpayers should be on the table and will have my full consideration,’ Min said. ‘During a year of record budget surpluses, the state should be returning tax dollars back to Californians.’” _[Orange County Register, [3/2/22](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=b92300d8b6&e=7017cc100e)]

**San Francisco Chronicle:** _"To stress his moderate support, Min emphasized his endorsement from law enforcement groups like the Los Angeles Police Protective League, the Association for Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs and the Peace Officers Research Association of California, which represents 950 public safety unions."_ [San Francisco Chronicle, [11/26/23](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=30f072b4ad&e=7017cc100e)]

**Orange County Register:** _“Of the five state senators who represent portions of Orange County, Sen. Dave Min authored the highest ratio of bills that became law this year, when local senators combined passed a total of 33 bills. Min also had the best attendance for key votes in the final month of the session, and he held the most town halls. [...] Eight of his bills were signed into law, including...one that will require courts to consider a parent’s history of violence and substance abuse before allowing them to have unsupervised visits with their children. [...] In the wake of the Dec. 1 oil spill off Huntington Beach, Min was the first legislator to call for a total ban on offshore drilling in California._ [Orange County Register, [12/20/21](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=33c78cd6ef&e=7017cc100e)]

**American Journal News:** GOP US House candidate Scott Baugh bankrolled by right-wing advocate for biblical law. [American Journal News, [10/16/23](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=4541b800a7&e=7017cc100e)]

_“Republican former California Assembly Member Scott Baugh, who lost a 2022 congressional race to Democratic Rep. Katie Porter, is running for her open House seat in 2024. Howard Fieldstead Ahmanson Jr., a right-wing megadonor and longtime advocate for strict biblical law, has been a top donor throughout Baugh’s political career.”_

**Los Angeles Times:** Baugh Indicted on Felony Charges in Campaign Ploy. [Los Angeles Times, [3/23/96](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d48b90fe83&e=7017cc100e)]

**Los Angeles Times:** Baugh’s Dirty Political Path to Power. [Los Angeles Times, [1/28/96](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=98b1793783&e=7017cc100e)]

_“As one of those ‘die-hard’ Republicans, it is difficult for me to express my disgust at the fraud and deceit that was necessary to ensure Scott Baugh was elected.”_

_“As far as I and many others are concerned, he is either a liar and a cheat or an ill-versed ‘puppet’ whose actions are dictated by the big-money ‘king-makers’ who have chosen to control the future of not only Orange County residents but loyal, law-abiding citizens of California as well!”_
**PATH TO VICTORY**
In California’s 47th Congressional District, Democrats hold a voter registration advantage that continues to trend away from Republicans – with Democratic registration shares increasing 4.5 points since 2016, and Republican shares falling nearly 4 points in that same period. This district is also approximately 11% Hispanic and 20% AANHPI – including an active Korean community – and is one of the most formally educated districts in the country, with over half of residents holding a college degree.

Dave Min has proven that he knows how to appeal to these voters, and Baugh has proven time and time again he does not. Elected in 2020, Min, a former business law professor at UC Irvine, unseated longtime Orange County Republican stalwart John Moorlach to represent the more than 1.1 million residents of California’s 37th Senate District. SD-37 includes more than 80% of the 47th Congressional District that Min is running to represent – including the cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Laguna Beach, and Newport Beach. Min won this area by more than 4% in 2020, showing he can win this highly contested Congressional District.

In this Democratic-leaning district, Min maintains a strong advantage thanks to his record as a bipartisan problem-solver, his history of electoral success within this same district, and his ability to overperform with his Democratic base.

In the face of Min’s formidable campaign operation, a broad coalition of electoral support within the 47th District – including nearly every single law enforcement union in California – and a long-time record of holding bad actors accountable, Scott Baugh won’t be able to hide his shady, criminal past and his dangerous agenda.

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=075fb5d4d2b3481a9b49d2fe2e24004d&_e=W6qdGpakUGqmRkzxD09P7xdtTmPBUR2-R4uMjWdaGIZfXT1qGjypY7A47OcuzRdeWbNEtPo0G7VZPwN-xrSNlmsjqOpLgIiHC7_d6xH_uMYIWQ8ghjhOZZVXop-LZNTddb3ifka29nKrQamG9jjk5y3w8P8qFzbNhpYy5aOl6iqUpvFp36RHeED5_Ol8zM_jGoggBuwINngBSq0zXFMsfzsUjg_YmEEchlE_c2k_SIFT5GOIFxdBO9NBrWU6riv4k5ytqBvy6AY77F8nmNiWzL0BiUCBvL1JTiY3P8jXxBrZNsX2ge9e60uyHqw7QK76HVNkDwi7zWi4Wazjuu3FgikwU6Dej1NhZ1R77IZVlnqguxwRQvk9lhK6RfSy4-bVLjUoCN0n-5nugV1smk0nSo7GLtB1EniVJkCZLN_t5C0%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=075fb5d4d2b3481a9b49d2fe2e24004d&_e=W6qdGpakUGqmRkzxD09P7xdtTmPBUR2-R4uMjWdaGIZfXT1qGjypY7A47OcuzRdeWbNEtPo0G7VZPwN-xrSNlmsjqOpLgIiHC7_d6xH_uMYIWQ8ghjhOZZVXop-LZNTddb3ifka29nKrQamG9jjk5y3w8P8qFzbNhpYy5aOl6iqUpvFp36RHeED5_Ol8zM_jGoggBuwINngBSq0zXFMsfzsUjg_YmEEchlE_c2k_SIFT5GOIFxdBO9NBrWU6riv45mqZXgZeoMLPZMe_LYGZOMYnO1yM3bbjt6gYPY278Q60kukMlwPOQWf8heU6zWUSpOGaOy2cq9bhWqWbJpSgg6fpSx3s5y-oOSY5EF3ImWWrBktku9geeWvLRg3fc_pYFwfPulpH1Y_odwUPm32JTx1RKwOP1RoxQsACd8iLeiM%3D)

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

### **We Did It, Repeal of RCV is on the ballot**
**Victory in Sight: Mobilizing Alaska Against Ranked Choice Voting In an unprecedented mobilization for electoral reform, our coalition has successfully ignited a statewide movement to challenge and propose the removal of Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) in Alaska.****With the unwavering dedication of over 700 volunteers, we've shattered expectations by gathering an astounding 43,000 signatures from Alaskans who share our vision for a more transparent and straightforward electoral process. This monumental achievement not only secured our position on the ballot but also paved the way for the citizens of Alaska to voice their desire for change.****The journey to this pivotal moment has been fueled by a year of relentless effort, strategic networking, and a deep commitment to our cause. Our volunteers have traversed every corner of Alaska, engaging with communities, explaining the complexities of RCV, and illuminating the benefits of a more direct voting system. This grassroots campaign has not only expanded our network but has also significantly raised awareness about the issues surrounding RCV.****As we stand on the brink of this historic opportunity, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has contributed to this cause. Your support has been the backbone of our campaign, providing us with the resources, energy, and motivation needed to confront and dismantle the RCV system in Alaska.****The early news release confirming our achievement marks not just a milestone for our movement but also a beacon of hope for those who believe in electoral reform. This is our chance to fundamentally transform Alaska's electoral landscape, ensuring a voting system that is straightforward, understandable, and truly reflective of the people's will.****Let's seize this moment and make history together. The ballot is our battleground, and with your continued support, we will achieve our goal of ridding Alaska of Ranked Choice Voting. The fight is far from over, but with our collective strength, determination, and the foundation we've built over the past year, victory is within our reach. Thank you, Alaska, for standing with us.****Together, we will restore simplicity and clarity to our elections, ensuring a future where every vote counts in the most straightforward manner possible. Let's move forward, united in our purpose and resolute in our mission to eliminate Ranked Choice Voting. The time for change is now, and with your help, we will make it a reality.**

### **Press Release**
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****Alaska Volunteers Triumph: Nearly 43,000 Signatures to Overturn Ranked Choice Voting** _**Anchorage, Alaska**_**– In a resounding demonstration of democratic engagement, a grassroots movement led by over 700 Alaskan volunteers has successfully gathered nearly 43,000 signatures, significantly exceeding the required 26,000, to propose the removal of Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) in Alaska. This monumental effort was completed a full month ahead of schedule, showcasing the determination and unity of Alaskans.****"This is not just a collection of signatures, but a profound statement by the people of Alaska," said Phil Izon, a lead organizer of the initiative. "Our volunteers, all Alaskans, have voiced their concerns and desires through this campaign. We've surpassed the number of signatures the Pro-RCV group initially gathered to introduce RCV, underlining a growing skepticism and desire for change among the electorate."****The movement has been a true grassroots effort, contrasting sharply with the Pro-RCV group, which reportedly spent over $7 million and relied on out-of-state resources to promote and push RCV on Alaska. "Our success was driven by Alaskans, for Alaskans. We did not need to fly in people or spend millions. Our strength came from the genuine support and hard work of our volunteers," Izon added.****This initiative represents a significant challenge to RCV, a system that has been increasingly scrutinized for its complexity and the perception that it obscures the straightforward principle of "one person, one vote." The organizers believe that this successful petition drive will resonate beyond Alaska, setting a precedent for other states considering RCV, we are a cautionary tale (Like a canary in coal mine, warning others about danger).****"We stand for the Alaskans who felt misled, for those who found the RCV ballot confusing, and for everyone who believes in the sanctity of the straightforward voting process," said Izon. "Our message is clear: it's time to remove Ranked Choice Voting from our state. 'Let's Take Out The Trash, Let’s Rid The Rank' is more than a slogan; it's a call to action for all Alaskans who value transparency and simplicity in their electoral system."****The submitted signatures will now undergo verification by state officials. When validated, this will pave the way for a ballot measure where Alaskans can directly vote on the future of RCV in their state.****"We did this for you, for every Alaskan who wants their vote to count in the most direct and understandable way. We urge all Alaskans to stand with us and vote to remove Rank Choice Voting. Together, we can ensure our electoral system reflects the true will of the people," concluded Izon.**

#### **The Tale of the Ranked Choice Voting Dragon**
---
In a land of breathtaking mountains and icy wonders, a story unfolds – a tale of determination and unity among the people of Alaska. This is the story of how over 700 Alaskan volunteers, driven by a shared purpose, embarked on a quest to challenge the mighty Ranked Choice Voting Dragon. It began as a murmur among the people, a shared sentiment that grew into a roaring call for change. The Ranked Choice Voting Dragon, a formidable creature reigning over the electoral landscape, needed to be confronted. To do this, a band of brave volunteers united, each one as determined as the other, each one a proud Alaskan. Their mission was daunting: to gather 40,000 signatures from across the vast and rugged terrain of Alaska, a number far exceeding the required 26,000. This was no small feat in a land where distances are great and the elements unforgiving. But the spirit of Alaskans is strong and resilient, born of the land they call home. From the fishing villages to the snow-capped peaks, from the bustling streets of Anchorage to the remote corners of the wilderness, these volunteers ventured. They worked tirelessly, their voices echoing the sentiment of thousands, their efforts a testament to their dedication to their cause and to their state. In every signature collected, there was a story – a story of an Alaskan who believed in the power of unity and the importance of their voice. Each signature was a pledge, a commitment to the vision of a different future, a future shaped by the will of the people. As they reached and surpassed their goal, the volunteers knew that their journey was about more than signatures. It was a journey of empowerment, a demonstration of what can be achieved when Alaskans come together for a common purpose. Their effort, By Alaskans, For Alaskans, was a beacon of hope and a symbol of the indomitable Alaskan spirit. And so, the story of these volunteers, their quest against the Ranked Choice Voting Dragon, became a legend, a reminder of the power of unity and the strength of the Alaskan heart. **On this International Women's Day, we're celebrating _all_ women – cis, trans, and femmes – who are demanding equality, peace, and justice for their communities. ** It takes _strength_ to stand in the face of inequality and demand better. Let today be a reminder that our progress is worth celebrating and our injustices are worth fighting against – _especially now_. Extremist Republicans have systematically restricted abortion rights, attacked LGBTQ+ rights, and denigrated and demeaned women of all backgrounds.__ Meanwhile, wages have stagnated, the cost of childcare has skyrocketed, and women make up just 28% of Congress (and that’s a record number). Peter,
Happy International Women’s Day!
Days like these allow us to reflect on how far we’ve come and how far we still have to go — when it comes to reproductive rights, equal pay, violence against women, and so much more.
It horrifies me to see my daughter growing up with fewer rights in Arizona than me.
Generations of women before us have fought for our fundamental rights. To vote, own property, have a credit card, marry who we want, and choose what we do with our own bodies.
The conservative majority on the Supreme Court set us back when they overturned Roe v. Wade . This decision was the result of a decades-long effort by the conservative movement in the United States, but our fight doesn’t end here.
If we allow ourselves to become complacent, conservatives will continue to undermine our reproductive freedom.
We’ve seen Republicans across the country start to attack in-vitro fertilization and access to birth control — and commit to a nationwide abortion ban if Donald Trump wins.
We won’t let that happen.
Southeast Arizona has an inspiring history of representation by women, from Gabby Giffords to Ann Kirkpatrick. I will be proud to follow in their footsteps in Congress and fight nonstop to protect abortion rights nationwide.
Peter, your grassroots support is what helps me fight for change.
We’re in one of the most competitive races in the whole country. Together, we can flip this district blue and continue the fight for women’s equality. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Republicans’ hypocrisy on IVF
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1208%2E135344%2EpK7_R5)

The hypocrisy is hard to take: In an article in the Detroit News this week, Former Congressman Mike Rogers, one of our 4 serious opponents, refused to commit on the record to supporting legislation to protect IVF federally – despite tweeting his support for IVF in the wake of the Alabama Supreme Court ruling. [You can read more about our opponents’ stances on the issues by clicking here.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/2432?t=2&akid=1208%2E135344%2EpK7_R5)
It’s just another example of why we need to believe candidates like Mike Rogers and other Republicans when they have shown us time and again exactly who they are.
Let’s review the bidding:
Rogers has a decades-long record as an anti-choice politician, including co-sponsoring 4 bills that would have had the same effect as the Alabama Supreme Court decision, making it impossible for millions of couples to grow their families. In the House of Representatives, he voted with his party 100% of the time on abortion-related issues.
His fellow Michigan Republican Senate candidates are no better:
* Former Congressman Peter Meijer, has campaigned on being “100% pro-life” even in cases of rape or incest, supported a federal ban on abortion, and co-sponsored a bill that would have prevented the disposal of frozen IVF embryos.

* Businessman Sandy Pensler says he is “a pro-life conservative;” called Roe v. Wade a “terrible decision,” and claimed that Prop 3 in Michigan, which protected the right to choose in Michigan’s Constitution, “went too far.”

* Former Congressman Justin Amash received an A+ rating from National Right to Life, an extreme anti-choice organization. In the Michigan House of Representatives he co-sponsored legislation to restrict IVF, subjecting clinics to onerous requirements and requiring them to share data about patient miscarriages with the state.

Meanwhile, despite trying to smooth over their talking points, their party’s agenda on reproductive freedom is clear, from attacks on servicemembers’ ability to travel to receive abortion care to a pending Supreme Court decision that could we ban the mailing of mifepristone across state lines – a safe and legal drug that has been widely used for over two decades for women having miscarriages, D&Cs;, medically necessary terminations and abortions. As the most common method of abortion, such a decision on mifepristone would limit access for women in states that have protected abortion—like Michigan. There’s no reason to think IVF is safe. Democrats introduced a bill to protect IVF nationwide. It has zero Republican co-sponsors in the House and was blocked in the Senate by Republicans last week.
The anti-choice movement spent 50 years chipping away at the federal right to an abortion. And now they’re continuing to chip away at reproductive freedom in all its forms, in all 50 states.
Our opponents spent decades in lockstep with their party on this issue, taking vote after vote to restrict choice. Today, Republicans see where the political winds are blowing and claim to support IVF, but politicians like Mike Rogers don’t even have the moral courage to say they’d support federal legislation protecting it.
The path to filibuster reform and a Democratic Senate (not to mention the White House) all run through Michigan. [**These types of decisions—whether and how to grow a family—are as personal as they come. I’ll always vote to protect Michiganders’ rights to make the decision that’s right for their family, and unlike some of my opponents, I’ve got the record to back it up.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240308-1-700&t=3&akid=1208%2E135344%2EpK7_R5)**

My journey to this moment, running for Congress in Oklahoma's 5th District, is deeply rooted in my personal experiences and the collective story of Oklahoma women. As someone who has faced and moved beyond childhood abuse and sexual assault—a reality shared by 40% of women in our state—my dedication to advocating for women's rights is deeply personal.
This commitment was further galvanized as I navigated the male-dominated field of cybersecurity. Facing and overcoming those barriers ignited my passion to empower women, to ensure they are represented and respected in every sphere of life. Through initiatives like 'Women in Cyber Leadership' and my work with 'Smart Girls' at the Boys and Girls Club, I've aimed to blend my personal experiences with professional leadership. I've strived to create opportunities for women and to ensure, I am reaching back.
In Oklahoma, the statistics paint a stark picture: we're last in the U.S. in several key indicators of women's well-being, from high rates of female incarceration to limited healthcare access, wage disparities, and more. These are not just numbers; they represent real lives, our mothers, daughters, sisters, and friends who face these challenges daily.
As we celebrate International Women's Day, it's important to remember the giants on whose shoulders we stand—women like Wilma Mankiller, Clara Luper, and Angie Debo, who paved the way for us in the fight for equality. Their legacy fuels my campaign and my vision for Oklahoma: to transform it from a state that ranks last in women's well-being.
My campaign is a pledge to prioritize women's health research, bolster WIC and family services, expand access to childcare, and ensure paid leave policies genuinely support Oklahoma families. Moreover, restoring women's reproductive rights nationally is crucial to guaranteeing safe and legal healthcare access in our state.
This International Women's Day, let's recommit to the cause of equality, to tearing down the barriers that remain. Together, we can build a future where every woman in Oklahoma feels secure, valued, and empowered to chase their dreams, without limitations.
Let's get to work,
Madison Horn

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: There's no arguing that Joe Biden and Martin Heinrich have let us down. | | Friend, America is clearly on the wrong track – over two-thirds of Americans agree, and you’re likely one of them. Less than 40% approve of the job Joe Biden is doing, and there’s no arguing that he and Martin Heinrich have let us down. But it’s more than that – together, they’ve pushed policies that are actively harming Americans; from our families, to our jobs, to our safety, to our freedoms. We’re on the wrong track, and we can and MUST do better. That’s why I’m running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico, These are SOME of New Mexico’s issues that are national issues that I will fight for when I reach the Senate: Securing the border , stopping the flow of fentanyl and human trafficking Lowering costs for hardworking Americans and unleashing American domestic energy Making neighborhoods safe for our families and supporting the police Improving education through choice and competition Destigmatizing and finally addressing mental illness But to get these things done, we need a Republican-controlled Senate so we have a majority that actually cares about these things. Flipping New Mexico will put the majority back in Republican hands, and that’s why your support in this race is so critical. We’ve taken the Democrats by surprise and have put this race on the map in 2024. As the official Republican nominee, Thank you, Nella Domenici Candidate for U.S. Senate, New Mexico | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. body:
[1]Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress

Alexandria
wrote a quick note to share what our movement has been able to accomplish
because of grassroots support from people like you.

[ https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240308.YVYk6b&refcode=em20240308-5961-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=5961%2E2526796%2EowzyV_ ]Read the note below and then click here to contribute today to help
power our fight for a brighter future for all.

[ https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240308.YVYk6b&refcode=em20240308-5961-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=5961%2E2526796%2EowzyV_ ]To our supporters and friends, I wanted to take a moment to thank you
for being a part of this movement — a people’s movement. The collective
power of your support and continued commitment to action has transformed
countless lives on both a personal and systemic level. Looking back at
just the past year, your support has allowed us to: Raise thousands of
dollars to support healthcare justice organizers, trans and LGBT+
advocacy, support for migrants, and relief efforts for everyday Americans
recovering from climate disasters, from California to Ohio to Maui, Grow
landmark support for our climate movement, adding 17 new cosponsors to the
Green New Deal, as well as develop an implementation guide to help local
governments and nonprofits apply for federal grants that meet Green New
Deal goals, Successfully push President Biden to keep pursuing student
loan debt cancellation — so far, they’ve forgiven over $132 billion for
nearly 4 million Americans — and create the Civilian Climate Corps, which
we hope to expand greatly in years to come, Be one of the original
cosponsors calling for a ceasefire — and we have worked to grow that
coalition to 66 members strong, All while providing a living wage to our
team of organizers on the ground! And there is even more to come. As we
push to hold special interests to account, fight for real action to combat
the climate emergency, and organize for change that actually centers
working people, your continued support means absolutely everything. If you
can, would you help power our fight with a contribution today? Will you
contribute your time to our organizing efforts this year? Whether you join
our volunteer effort virtually or here in New York, our people-powered
work needs your voice. I am so grateful for all this movement has done and
continues to accomplish — because of you. On behalf of my team, and our
movement: thank you. Pa’lante, Alexandria

[ https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240308.YVYk6b&refcode=em20240308-5961-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=5961%2E2526796%2EowzyV_ ]Contribute $5

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.ocasiocortez.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe-old/?akid=5961%2E2526796%2EowzyV_

Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.
Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children.
After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last.
I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith.
Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, the Super PACs are attacking me, and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this seat.
I made the decision to run again because I knew I could count on people like you to help me win, so it would mean so much to me if you could chip in to my campaign today:

Among the candidates to defeat Scott Perry, I’m not the most attractive. I’m not the most well-known. I’m not the tallest. I’m not the youngest. I’m not the skinniest. I don’t have the most hair. I don’t have the most money. And I’m not looking for a second career.

I get all that.

But, as stated in the recent television debate, _“I bring more experience, expertise, and empathy to this race than anyone else.”_ I will best represent you and our communities in Congress because _“I guarantee that I listen carefully to**EVERYONE**. I will represent **EVERYONE**. And I care about **EVERYONE** in our District.”_

And I’m doing more to educate the voters of this district about the issues we face – and how I will help our people – than any other candidate.

Why should you take my word for it? Here’s why.

You’ve probably seen the [candidate scorecard](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80594558/459825226/-1228070279?source=RC_EM_EN_WL_240308_1_1&refcode2=763117e5-97dd-ee11-85fb-002248223794&contactdata=FOk4XzZ6LOZxbhc5J9BCIL6tbiiXhCQ/AEehRYTgnVXiocaKQUzYUmgapEQdG8+J&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjMxMTdlNS05N2RkLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qe8pb_8A_vn5ZUBeLmj1GA2GgMbaffF1M0U5PL8bam4=&emci=05f7251c-8ddd-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=763117e5-97dd-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=24669367) I give people when I go door-to-door. I didn’t check the boxes for the other candidates because I didn’t want to misrepresent them – and because I want to encourage voters to do their own research.

And now, to help you, I’m going to do something that no other candidate has done or would do. I’m giving you the links to their websites so you can easily compare us and decide for yourself who is already working hard to earn your vote.

| Friend, It's official: I'm running for U.S. Senate in Michigan. And my platform is simple:
* Follow the Constitution.
* Read the bills.
* Stop governing by emergency.
* End the forever war.
* Cut taxes & spending.
* Stop borrowing trillions.
* No central bank digital currency (CBDC).
* Protect free speech.
* Repeal the Patriot Act & FISA 702.
* No qualified immunity for government officials.
* End civil asset forfeiture.

This shouldn't be hard, but over and over again our elected officials are ignoring the Constitution, voting for bills they know little about, signing away their authority to the executive branch, and spending more than we can afford. They recklessly put the troops in harm's way (or defend it when the president does), and they have no issues with spying on you and quashing your freedom of speech. That's the establishment way, and the establishment is going to do whatever it can to maintain the status quo. [**If you're ready for something different, please stand with me and support this campaign by giving whatever you can.**](https://connect.justinamash.com/r?u=TR4WyU-_hMxDN7-StohPW0bg2qMfdKCjGw9f05VMUuTkae9OvFf1PyTtC6Y08LlLoVhNJl2g5QNexJSCiTS1Og&e=3ebc65ae19a1c85b4d26eca84f9aae52&utm_source=justinamash&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lets_shake_things_up10&n=2) | [](https://connect.justinamash.com/r?u=TR4WyU-_hMxDN7-StohPW0bg2qMfdKCjGw9f05VMUuTkae9OvFf1PyTtC6Y08LlLoVhNJl2g5QNexJSCiTS1Og&e=3ebc65ae19a1c85b4d26eca84f9aae52&utm_source=justinamash&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lets_shake_things_up10&n=3 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://connect.justinamash.com/r?u=TR4WyU-_hMxDN7-StohPW0bg2qMfdKCjGw9f05VMUuTkae9OvFf1PyTtC6Y08LlLoVhNJl2g5QNexJSCiTS1Og&e=3ebc65ae19a1c85b4d26eca84f9aae52&utm_source=justinamash&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lets_shake_things_up10&n=3)

Radicals in Tallahassee and state capitals across the country are pushing increasingly extreme attacks on our right to choose. They're targeting abortions, birth control, and even IVF. This is a fight for the most basic of our rights — privacy, freedom, and the choice to live our lives as we please. And if we're going to win this fight, we'll need _all hands on deck_.

Radicals in Tallahassee and state capitals across the country are pushing increasingly extreme attacks on our right to choose. They're targeting abortions, birth control, and even IVF. This is a fight for the most basic of our rights — privacy, freedom, and the choice to live our lives as we please. And if we're going to win this fight, we'll need all hands on deck. So before the end of International Women's Day, I'm asking you to add your name to my new petition and help me reach my 100,000 signature goal. | | In the aftermath of the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, we've watched in horror as ultraconservative extremists across the nation have rolled back our rights before our eyes. Just the thought that my daughters will grow up with fewer rights than I've enjoyed for most of my life makes me sick. But it goes to show that we can never take progress for granted. So this International Women's Day, I'm asking you to recommit to this fight and refuse to give up, even when it's hard. We can't — not when these dangerous, regressive bans have left women's lives and futures at stake. I vow to always fight — today and every day — for women's right to choose, to survive, and to thrive. But I'm just one person, friend. Peter,

From the Permian Basin to the South Valley of Albuquerque, my team and I have continued to cover New Mexico’s 2nd Congressional District in February.

We’ve said it before, and we’ll say it again: everywhere we go, New Mexicans are ready for leadership that listens to their needs. clean_body: From the Permian Basin to the South Valley of Albuquerque, my team and I have continued to cover New Mexico’s 2nd Congressional District in February. | | Peter, From the Permian Basin to the South Valley of Albuquerque, my team and I have continued to cover New Mexico’s 2nd Congressional District in February. We’ve said it before, and we’ll say it again: everywhere we go, New Mexicans are ready for leadership that listens to their needs. Constituents don’t need us to tell them what a disaster ‘Bidenomics’ is or how dangerously open our borders are; they feel it every day at the grocery store and see the effects in their communities. Here are some highlights from the campaign trail this past month. UPDATES FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL Visiting with local business owners in Hobbs! Excellent examples of local small businesses providing a big impact to their community. We had a blast seeing old friends at the Doña Ana County Republican Party Pre-Primary Convention. Speaking at the Deming Lincoln Day Dinner. My hometown of Alamogordo earned the ALTUS Award. This is the gold standard of community support for a military installation. I am so proud of our community and Holloman AFB for their well-deserved recognition. It was such an honor to be the keynote speaker for the Sierra County Republican Party Lincoln Day Dinner. Talking solutions with Mike Shineberry at my hometown station. Supporting Albuquerque’s local businesses at the Albuquerque Hispano Chamber of Commerce’s annual La Noche Encantada event. Great food and good friends at Barela’s Coffee House. We can’t cruise through Bernalillo County without hopping on the radio with our good friends at KKOB Radio. Brandon Vogt and I can talk all day about the issues that really matter to constituents. If you’re in the Albuquerque area, make sure to RSVP and stop by our Meet & Greet on March 16th. RSVP GET INVOLVED 241\. That’s how many days we have left to re-take this seat and restore common-sense New Mexico values to D.C. There are many ways you can help our campaign as we work to reach voters, spread our message, and win support. * I am continually humbled and grateful for the enthusiastic and broad support I am met with as I continue to travel our beautiful state. We deserve so much better than what we’re getting from our non-representatives in D.C. I hope I can count on your continued support in our fight, and I look forward to seeing you out on the campaign trail! For New Mexico, Yvette Herrell | Born and raised in New Mexico, Yvette Herrell served for 4 terms in the New Mexico House of Representatives. body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80595969/459829550/-1745565447?refcode=em_msg_2024.03.08_b1_es_all-nd&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTEyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MWU4ZWJiMi05ZGRkLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=flUaJF35izdt5R6t4sX5K9cM1R4WVHPPsAlTLyyStlI=) Hi Peter,

Throughout Women’s History Month, and especially on today, International Women’s Day, I want to celebrate all those who came before me who helped make my service in Congress even possible.

Today, I am grateful for the leaders from our community like Kimberlé Crenshaw, Betty Sutton, Ilene Shapiro, and First Lady Ida Saxton McKinley who unapologetically took a stand for women’s rights and freedoms. And I never forget that it is thanks to the tireless work and fearless advocacy of Black leaders, like Congresswoman Shirley Chisholm and Stephanie Tubbs Jones, that a Black woman like me is able to serve as a member of the United States Congress.

But all across the country, women’s rights are under attack. The fight for women’s rights, freedoms, and equality continues as we work to protect access to reproductive healthcare and the ability for women to make their own healthcare decisions, expand childcare, eliminate the wage gap, and so much more.

This month and every month, I’m committed to channeling the power of those who came before me to continue opening doors, shattering glass ceilings, and building a more inclusive future.

I am so excited for the future and all we can accomplish together — **[but I need you with me over these critical next few months.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80595970/459829551/-1745565447?refcode=em_msg_2024.03.08_b1_es_all-nd&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTEyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MWU4ZWJiMi05ZGRkLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=flUaJF35izdt5R6t4sX5K9cM1R4WVHPPsAlTLyyStlI=)**

Happy International Women’s Day — thanks for all you do.

_Emilia_

She learned from a young age how to use her voice and the power of the people to create change.** **In 2022, Congresswoman Sykes was elected to represent Ohio’s newly redrawn 13th Congressional District, winning one of the toughest races in the country._Emilia has cut through the divisiveness to deliver results._ **

I’m running for Congress once again because of the support of the women who raised me.
Team—I would not have made it to Congress were it not for the women in my life.

I was raised by a single mom who had to work multiple jobs to make ends meet, as our family relied on Section 8 housing and food stamps. When child care was too expensive, I’d often go to work with my grandma to help her clean homes in our Rockland community.

Despite our circumstances, my mom and grandma raised me with the audacity to dream big —and I did. Because of their support, I went on to law school and represented my community in Congress. **I’m running once again because of the support of the women who raised me.**

[**I will never stop fighting for a better, more equitable, future for all women. Peter, today, we’re pulling back the curtain -- Right now, Hill is being massively out-raised by his opponent, and it looks like we’re already falling behind on our own fundraising goals for the month. We know plenty of candidates and organizations are reaching out to ask for your support this month, but Hill’s race is too consequential to leave to chance: We have the opportunity to buck the Washington establishment and send a true progressive to the U.S. Senate -- one who will unapologetically fight for universal health care access, criminal justice reform, a $15 federal minimum wage, workers' rights, and more. We have the opportunity to reject another six years of broken promises and snails-pace progress under established career politicians -- the same type of “leaders” that have allowed stagnant wages, skyrocketing housing costs, and record-breaking inflation to keep our communities from thriving. We have the opportunity to elect someone who truly represents and embodies Michigan communities -- a single father, small business owner, and union organizer committed to putting PEOPLE and COMMUNITIES, not special interests and corporations, first. But Peter, this much is certain: It will not happen if we let corporate interests and dark money decide this Senate race. The establishment is determined to elect a moderate who will toe the party line and keep business going as usual in Washington, and we’ve seen where that’s gotten us. That’s why we MUST elect Hill Harper, a true Washington outsider, to flip that dynamic on its head and deliver the people-first leadership Michigan deserves. Friend,
I was impressed with Biden's speech last night. He touched on all the issues important to Americans.
Most importantly, it underscored the need for issue-based leadership in our district. One thing that sets me apart from my opponents is how I'm campaigning— I'm unafraid to talk about issues, make my positions known, and speak out about the things that matter.
I've recently drafted a "State of our District" [https://www.votedrbob.com/post/bob-lorinser-pens-the-state-of-our-district-after-sotu-1] address, highlighting just a few areas where we are challenged and can improve.
Friends, we need resources to fund our massive outreach program to get our message out to the entire district. Your contributions fund that effort. Thank you.
I'm proud of our accomplishments, but like many in rural America, I worry about my country. When half of Congress last night offered ovations and others jeered, our national divisions were apparent.
We can't just be a 'Republican-led House' and 'Democratic-led Senate and President.' It's the People's House, Senate, and President.
We can never forget hardworking everyday people.
Our government and its systems can endure only through the resiliency of the people who uphold and protect its ideals.
The nation could learn from my district. Despite poor Congressional leadership, we tackle problems with grit, strength, and loyalty to our friends, family, neighbors, and communities.
If our representative legislated with the same fiercely independent spirit as his constituents, the strength of our district would rival anywhere in the country.
Thank you for contributing to help me help us all thrive. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser

Democrat, MI01

Team, Last night, President Biden delivered the final State of the Union address of his first term. I want to share some thoughts — **[but first, could you make a quick $5 contribution to support my historic campaign for Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80597166/459833529/-2061133837?refcode=em20240308&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDczZThlNi1hMGRkLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1OPtge30MKGEIqp_wUi6PoocXWcPxdzSp2Qj6h9vpow=)** While most of the attention last night was focused on the President’s rousing speech in which he laid out a convincing case for his second term, I could not help but notice something else: Speaker Mike Johnson’s invited guests. **Last night, Speaker Johnson’s extremism and his disturbing desire for a broader push to restrict LGBTQ+ rights were on full display.** Speaker Johnson has a lengthy record of bigotry and discrimination toward the LGBTQ+ community, particularly trans people. So I guess it should come as no surprise that he invited not one, but two guests to the State of the Union who have been vocal opponents of trans rights. While President Biden made the case for his second term with a vision of continued progress and a better, brighter future for all Americans, Speaker Johnson continued to surround himself with extreme individuals who want to drag us back to the past — on LGBTQ+ issues and so much more. Unlike Johnson, I share President Biden’s vision. **That’s why I’m running for Congress** — to stand up to right-wing hate and bigotry, defend our democracy from the likes of Speaker Johnson, and advocate for a strong, inclusive future. I’ll be honest: Democrats have _a lot of work_ ahead of us this election year, but if we do the work, it will pay off in November. And I am more committed than ever to this fight. Our campaign is powered by grassroots contributions from people like you — **[so can you chip in $5 right now to help our movement win in November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80597167/459833531/-2061133837?refcode=em20240308&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDczZThlNi1hMGRkLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1OPtge30MKGEIqp_wUi6PoocXWcPxdzSp2Qj6h9vpow=)** Thank you! Sarah McBride

clean_body: Last night, Speaker Johnson’s anti-LGBTQ extremism was on full display. | Team, Last night, President Biden delivered the final State of the Union address of his first term. I want to share some thoughts — = While most of the attention last night was focused on the President’s rousing speech in which he laid out a convincing case for his second term, I could not help but notice something else: Speaker Mike Johnson’s invited guests. Last night, Speaker Johnson’s extremism and his disturbing desire for a broader push to restrict LGBTQ+ rights were on full display. Speaker Johnson has a lengthy record of bigotry and discrimination toward the LGBTQ+ community, particularly trans people. So I guess it should come as no surprise that he invited not one, but two guests to the State of the Union who have been vocal opponents of trans rights. While President Biden made the case for his second term with a vision of continued progress and a better, brighter future for all Americans, Speaker Johnson continued to surround himself with extreme individuals who want to drag us back to the past — on LGBTQ+ issues and so much more. Unlike Johnson, I share President Biden’s vision. That’s why I’m running for Congress — to stand up to right-wing hate and bigotry, defend our democracy from the likes of Speaker Johnson, and advocate for a strong, inclusive future. I’ll be honest: Democrats have a lot of work ahead of us this election year, but if we do the work, it will pay off in November. And I am more committed than ever to this fight. | | In this latest newsletter below, Dom categorically addresses a critical environmental issue that affects our community. She discusses the new oil sheen found in Huntington Beach and outlines her plan for combatting such hazards. Make sure to read Dom's memorandum to stay informed and learn about the actions she is suggesting we take in coastal Orange County to protect our environment.

| | MEMORANDUMTO: All Concerned Of Coastal Orange CountySeal Beach, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Laguna BeachFROM: Dom Jones, Candidate for State Assembly AD72DATE: March 8, 2024 SUBJECT: Proactive Measures in Response to Huntington Beach Oil Sheen Incident I am writing to address a matter of immediate concern that affects our community – the recently reported 2.5-mile-long oil sheen, 1.5 miles off the coast of Huntington Beach, yet again. In less than 2 years our precious coastline has become hit once again by the awful crude oil platforms that are digging in our beautiful ocean that serves as a community Pool for all families to enjoy in magnificent coastal Orange County.-Do we want to invite our friends to enjoy a day at the beach and bring our children to swim in oil? This hurts our tourist economy, our lifestyles, and our home values drastically. This MUST end.-This incident highlights the urgent need for comprehensive action to protect our environment and the well-being of our residents. Background:As many of you are aware, the 1970s oil derricks and offshore platforms in the Huntington Beach area have been a source of ongoing environmental degradation. The recent oil sheen incident underscores the pressing need to reassess our reliance on these outdated structures and transition towards cleaner, more sustainable alternatives. Immediate Action Steps:In response to the Huntington Beach oil sheen incident, I am proposing the following immediate action steps: 1\. Shutdown of 1970s Oil Derricks: I am a proponent of initiating a comprehensive plan to safely shut down and decommission the aging and highly dangerous oil derricks that pose a heightened risk to our coastal environment, health of our sea life and the health of our families and children. With of course careful consideration as to how this can be done to protect our most vulnerable environmental frontiers in our region. 2\. Phased Decommissioning of Offshore Platforms: I encourage us to develop a phased approach to decommission offshore platforms, taking into account environmental impact assessments, laborer livelihood, economic considerations, and the safety of our coastal communities. 3\. Transition to Renewable Energy: I will advocate for policies and incentives to accelerate the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources, fostering a more sustainable and environmentally friendly energy landscape. 4\. Strengthened Regulatory Oversight: Collaborate with regulatory bodies to enhance monitoring and enforcement mechanisms, ensuring strict adherence to environmental standards within the offshore drilling industry. We want to ensure that there is firm adherence to protection of our oceans. Community Engagement:I am committed to fostering open dialogue and collaboration with our community throughout this process. Your input, concerns, and ideas are invaluable as we work together to address this critical issue. Stay Informed:For a detailed overview of these proposed measures and our ongoing efforts, please stay attuned to my comprehensive and feasible plan, via the next memorandum update. This will help protect our coastal communities and bring economic prosperity while doing so.It is essential that we stay informed and engaged in the collective endeavor to protect our environment and build a sustainable future for Orange County. Your support in these crucial initiatives is vital, and I deeply encourage you to share your thoughts and feedback as we move forward. You can reach me through my team at contact@domjones.orgThank you for your dedication to the well-being of our community. Sincerely,Dom JonesYour Future State Assemblywoman on November 8th, 2024Candidate for State Assembly
