Make sure to read Dom's memorandum to stay informed and learn about the actions she is suggesting we take in coastal Orange County to protect our environment. | | | | MEMORANDUMTO: All Concerned Of Coastal Orange CountySeal Beach, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Laguna BeachFROM: Dom Jones, Candidate for State Assembly AD72DATE: March 8, 2024 SUBJECT: Proactive Measures in Response to Huntington Beach Oil Sheen Incident I am writing to address a matter of immediate concern that affects our community – the recently reported 2.5-mile-long oil sheen, 1.5 miles off the coast of Huntington Beach, yet again. In less than 2 years our precious coastline has become hit once again by the awful crude oil platforms that are digging in our beautiful ocean that serves as a community Pool for all families to enjoy in magnificent coastal Orange County.-Do we want to invite our friends to enjoy a day at the beach and bring our children to swim in oil? This hurts our tourist economy, our lifestyles, and our home values drastically. This MUST end.-This incident highlights the urgent need for comprehensive action to protect our environment and the well-being of our residents. Background:As many of you are aware, the 1970s oil derricks and offshore platforms in the Huntington Beach area have been a source of ongoing environmental degradation. The recent oil sheen incident underscores the pressing need to reassess our reliance on these outdated structures and transition towards cleaner, more sustainable alternatives. Immediate Action Steps:In response to the Huntington Beach oil sheen incident, I am proposing the following immediate action steps: 1\. Shutdown of 1970s Oil Derricks: I am a proponent of initiating a comprehensive plan to safely shut down and decommission the aging and highly dangerous oil derricks that pose a heightened risk to our coastal environment, health of our sea life and the health of our families and children. With of course careful consideration as to how this can be done to protect our most vulnerable environmental frontiers in our region. 2\. Phased Decommissioning of Offshore Platforms: I encourage us to develop a phased approach to decommission offshore platforms, taking into account environmental impact assessments, laborer livelihood, economic considerations, and the safety of our coastal communities. 3\. Transition to Renewable Energy: I will advocate for policies and incentives to accelerate the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources, fostering a more sustainable and environmentally friendly energy landscape. 4\. Strengthened Regulatory Oversight: Collaborate with regulatory bodies to enhance monitoring and enforcement mechanisms, ensuring strict adherence to environmental standards within the offshore drilling industry. We want to ensure that there is firm adherence to protection of our oceans. Community Engagement:I am committed to fostering open dialogue and collaboration with our community throughout this process. Your input, concerns, and ideas are invaluable as we work together to address this critical issue. Stay Informed:For a detailed overview of these proposed measures and our ongoing efforts, please stay attuned to my comprehensive and feasible plan, via the next memorandum update. This will help protect our coastal communities and bring economic prosperity while doing so.It is essential that we stay informed and engaged in the collective endeavor to protect our environment and build a sustainable future for Orange County. Your support in these crucial initiatives is vital, and I deeply encourage you to share your thoughts and feedback as we move forward. You can reach me through my team at contact@domjones.orgThank you for your dedication to the well-being of our community. Sincerely,Dom JonesYour Future State Assemblywoman on November 8th, 2024Candidate for State Assembly | | | | | JOIN OUR DYNAMIC RANKS OF VOLUNTEERS & STAFF! | | | | ALSO WE ARE SEEKING STRONG ORGANIZERS & TEAM LEADS! | | | | EMAIL: CONTACT@DOMJONES.ORG FOR MORE INFO! | | | | | | | | Share on social | | | | This email was sent from .

| | Peter, Being a military spouse isn’t easy.

I stood by my husband Hung through constant moves, deployments, and injuries.

I had to answer “When is Dad coming home?” for my kids more times than I could count.
---
[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=aa07f5091b4142729f9bdf83fce372f1&_e=swAgti3P4aTVUZdgTCz67LAHddS2sy0FH0zSCiqMRfEg1TIFciZReRCfH3xp4RM0p3MrwVSthTAo5buaJBwRfTVPOmq0tvXoHy6ag5OBhct87hFR-iSJvbSVuZ4yHd7TtlbNx70kAGOhwah-yi2dfUoRSwNVD9sPRPUZgflDaIByH4eKdkB-0STcTTF5XEEvZLomJO-vP0Pv_pHd52A4nimAhaM4M7OPOY8YXhjKPFa3pzl_6bRR0jd1O17BP0OQxsw4rSVdSxDFD9PiLdnpJJu1K91PQhrNbeWAUCs2UFO7t8bufJTkG2Y5aLq6lgUilAbIxJvD2xOSqDVsrzeQq0Zyswoxquf9gW75EiyoTQ2C-cnDDJN7QaA8oFLZ6F6BkJOLqP9m5akMdLr_NPdERQ%3D%3D)
---
_But through all the sacrifices, it was worth it because I was married to an amazing man who was defending our country for our children._

| | Greetings #TeamAlsobrooks, Another fantastic week on the campaign trail! Everyday our grassroots campaign keeps growing bigger and bigger, all because of the work from you, our supporters. So keep knocking on doors, participating in phone banks, and telling all your friends about Angela Alsobrooks! It’s the way we’re going to win this thing! In case you missed it, here’s what’s been happening for the past week on the campaign trail and beyond: Dozens of new volunteers came to Largo to learn more about our grassroots campaign and how to get involved. We have been truly honored by the support #TeamAlsobrooks has received from the people of Maryland. This is how we win— with the support of everyday people fighting with us for a better today, better tomorrow, and a better Maryland! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=27&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) Across the country, anti-choice extremists are waging wars against women and families by attempting to strip us of the freedoms we hold dear. We met with health care experts and advocates from Maryland to talk about what the majority of Americans know - IVF and abortion bans are cruel and dangerous. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=28&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) It was a pleasure to be joined by Senator Kirsten Gillibrand in Bethesda! She has been a fierce advocate in fighting for women and families in the Senate, and we can’t wait to partner with her to get big things done for our country. Thank you to Kathleen Matthews, Dixie Noonan and Betsy Williams for bringing together such a wonderful group. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=29&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=30&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) What a spectacular morning in Bethesda, meeting with folks and discussing the Senate race. It’s been such a pleasure to hear from Marylanders first hand. As always, great to see our friends Michelle and Will Jawando. Thanks to Marie Sylla Dixon for hosting an amazing gathering. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=31&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) Thank you to the Women’s Democratic Club of Maryland for hosting an excellent forum and giving us the opportunity to share our plans for the U.S. Senate with Marylanders from across the state. On May 14th, with all of us working together, we will win and give every person in this state their first chance at success. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=32&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=33&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) We were overjoyed to participate in fellowship at Celebration Church in Columbia. Thank you to Bishop Robbie Davis for leading an uplifting and inspiring service. Thanks for having us, we can't wait to visit again soon! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=34&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) When Mitch McConnell got involved in this race, he sent a clear message to Marylanders — our right to make decisions about our bodies is directly on the ballot. We are honored to stand with EMILYs List, End Citizens United, and Reproductive Freedom for All in defense of reproductive freedom. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=24&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) Great to meet with labor leaders in Baltimore! Supporting Maryland's workers is one of our top priorities in the U.S. Senate. We are so excited to have the support of unions from across our state because they know that Team Alsobrooks stops at nothing to support workers with fair wages for their work and ensure their rights are protected. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13063?t=25&amount=25&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3) **UPCOMING EVENTS** **Friday, March 8th (Fort Washington)** \- PGC-NAACP Candidate Forum - **[RSVP Here](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12972?t=7&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3)**
**Saturday, March 9th (Rockville)** \- Montgomery County Meet and Greet - **[RSVP Here](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12973?t=8&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3)**
**Saturday, March 9th (Silver Spring)** \- Canvass with Angela and Higher Heights - **[RSVP Here](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13665?t=9&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3)**
**Sunday, March 10th (Baltimore)** \- 1000 Women for Alsobrooks - **[RSVP Here](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13723?t=10&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3)** _**[For more events, or to find volunteer opportunities in your area click here!](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/10004?t=11&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3)**_ **NEWS OF THE WEEK** **[Former prosecutor Angela Alsobrooks seeks to bring ‘results’ for Maryland voters with historic campaign](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13661?t=12&akid=1185%2E52803%2E5pjOb3)**
